paper.title: Fiber Fingerprints of Hidden Learning-State Dynamics
paper.abstract: A learning system can occupy execution states that are indistinguishable under every declared present-behavior readout yet respond differently to future training. We formalize this through fiber fingerprints: controlled future-learning response laws restricted to present-behavior equivalence classes. Prefix-compatible finite probes induce a predictive quotient functor, a Nerode-type minimal recursively sufficient representation, and a canonical set-level predictive fiber without assuming smoothn

summary.core_problem: 形式化描述一种现象：两个学习系统在所有当前行为读出上不可区分，但在后续训练中的响应可能不同。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是学习动态的理论框架。它试图给“隐藏学习状态”一个可操作的等价类和预测表示，对训练动态、模型状态可辨识性和 continual learning 的分析有边际参考价值，但距离 LLM 预训练实证较远。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 fiber fingerprints，即在当前行为等价类内，用受控未来训练响应律刻画隐藏状态差异。它进一步构造 prefix-compatible finite probes、predictive quotient functor、Nerode 型最小递归充分表示和 canonical predictive fiber；在有限维 Hilbert 实现下，把响应分解为 visible、visible-mode-reuse 和 irreducible-new sectors，并讨论 history-reachability、graph-Hodge chronology decomposition、regular switching class 以及 Adam moment sector。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看主要是数学形式化和条件机制结果，没有报告 LLM、Transformer 或大规模训练实验。摘要中出现了 root-mean-square scale 为 sqrt(p)η^{3/2} 的 switching class 标度和 Adam moment sector 的精确分解，但没有给出实证验证设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper formalizes the possibility that learning systems can be indistinguishable under all present-behavior readouts while responding differently to future training.
summary_en.importance: This is a theoretical contribution on hidden learning-state dynamics. It may be useful for thinking about trainability, state identifiability, and continual training, but it is far from empirical LLM pretraining practice.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces fiber fingerprints: controlled future-learning response laws restricted to present-behavior equivalence classes. The framework builds prefix-compatible finite probes, a predictive quotient functor, a Nerode-style minimal recursively sufficient representation, and a canonical predictive fiber. Under a finite-dimensional Hilbert realization, responses are decomposed into visible, visible-mode-reuse, and irreducible-new sectors, with additional results on history reachability, graph-Hodge chronology, regular switching classes, and Adam moments.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract suggests a primarily mathematical treatment rather than experiments on LLMs or large neural networks. It states a regular switching scale of sqrt(p)η^{3/2} and exact Adam moment-sector structure, but does not describe empirical validation.

recommendation.zh: 理论味很重，可能提醒别把 eval 等价当训练状态等价；若要读，只看定义和 Adam 部分。
recommendation.en: Heavy theory, but it usefully warns against equating behavioral equivalence with training-state equivalence; read the definitions and Adam section only.

paper.title: The data geometry of masking diffusion: Certified-optimal schedules via unmasking growth complexity
paper.abstract: We study masking diffusion for discrete sampling and introduce a path-resolved measure of data geometry called the \emph{unmasking growth complexity} ({\textsf{UGC}\xspace}). Its local increments directly control Kullback--Leibler (KL) discretization error, yielding a unified analysis of Bernoulli-subset and fixed-cardinality unmasking schemes. In log-reveal-odds coordinates, this structure yields optimized single-block and multi-block schedules, and quantifies the gains from adapting computatio

summary.core_problem: 离散掩码扩散（masking diffusion）采样器的精度与并行度之间如何权衡？能否用一个与数据几何相关的量来统一解释并优化不同 unmasking 方案（Bernoulli-subset 与 fixed-cardinality）的调度，并给出可从样本估计、带高概率 KL 证书的最优采样器？
summary.importance: 对 masked/any-order LM（如 MDLM、LLaDA、SEDD 这一脉）的采样调度设计有直接理论价值。它把 KL 离散化误差与一个沿 reveal 路径可加的几何量 UGC 联系起来，给出了从数据估计局部难度、自适应分配步数的原则性做法，而不是靠手工调 cosine/linear schedule。对做 diffusion LM 推理加速和训练目标分析的研究者有参考意义，但偏理论，工程上需要自己落地估计器。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 unmasking growth complexity（UGC），沿 reveal 路径定义局部增量，证明该增量直接控制 KL 离散化误差，从而统一分析 fixed-cardinality 与 Bernoulli-subset 两种 unmasking。在 log-reveal-odds 坐标下推导单块与多块最优调度；UGC 沿路径可加，因此局部增量可通过耦合 reveal 轨迹上的 KL 增量从样本估计。基于估计量构造数据依赖的采样器，在高概率下达到指定 KL 误差，迭代复杂度相对 oracle 只差常数因子。细分区极限下，log-reveal-odds UGC 密度的平方根积分决定分区复杂度和最优 Euler 离散化误差的主项。
summary.experiments: 论文以理论结果为主：给出 Bernoulli unmasking 与 fixed-cardinality unmasking 的统一 KL 误差界，相对 Chen et al. 的 fixed-cardinality 界更紧，并给出与 CTMC 分析（Dmitriev et al.）可比的 Bernoulli 保证；证明基于样本估计的 certified-optimal 采样器在高概率下达到预设 KL 误差，迭代复杂度在 oracle 的常数倍内；推导了块边界优化与多块调度的闭式/优化形式。全文未提供大规模生成模型实证，主要是合成/理论验证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议先看 Introduction 中 Q1/Q2 的定位以及与 Chen et al.、Lavenant-Zanella、Dmitriev et al. 的差异，再看 UGC 定义和主定理（KL 误差由 UGC 增量控制）。重点关注 log-reveal-odds 坐标下的调度优化和从样本估计 UGC 增量的耦合轨迹构造，这是把理论变成可用调度器的关键。预计 1–1.5 小时。做 diffusion LM 工程的人可跳过部分证明细节，抓结论和估计器形式。

summary_en.core_problem: How to trade off accuracy against parallelism in discrete masking diffusion samplers? Can a data-geometric quantity uniformly explain and optimize schedules across Bernoulli-subset and fixed-cardinality unmasking schemes, and yield samplers whose KL error is estimable from data and comes with high-probability certificates?
summary_en.importance: Relevant to sampling-schedule design for masked/any-order language models in the MDLM/LLaDA/SEDD line. It ties KL discretization error to an additive path-resolved geometric quantity (UGC), giving a principled way to estimate local difficulty from data and allocate denoising steps adaptively, rather than hand-tuning cosine or linear schedules. The paper is primarily theoretical; practitioners would need to implement the estimator themselves, but the framing is useful for anyone working on diffusion-LM inference or training-objective analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines unmasking growth complexity (UGC) with local increments along the reveal path and shows these increments directly control KL discretization error, yielding a unified analysis of fixed-cardinality and Bernoulli-subset unmasking. In log-reveal-odds coordinates, derives optimized single-block and multi-block schedules. Because UGC is additive along the path, its increments can be estimated from samples via KL increments on coupled reveal trajectories. These estimates yield data-dependent samplers that achieve a prescribed KL error with high probability, with iteration complexity within a constant factor of the oracle. In the fine-partition limit, the square-root integral of the log-reveal-odds UGC density governs partition complexity and the leading optimal Euler discretization error.
summary_en.experiments: Results are theoretical: unified KL error bounds for both Bernoulli and fixed-cardinality unmasking, sharpening prior fixed-cardinality bounds (Chen et al.) and giving Bernoulli guarantees comparable to CTMC analyses (Dmitriev et al.); certified-optimal samplers that meet a target KL error with high probability at constant-factor overhead over an oracle; closed-form or optimization-based block-boundary and multi-block schedules. No large-scale generative-model experiments; validation is analytical/synthetic.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Start with the Q1/Q2 framing in the introduction and the positioning relative to Chen et al., Lavenant-Zanella, and Dmitriev et al. Then focus on the UGC definition, the main theorem linking UGC increments to KL error, the log-reveal-odds schedule optimization, and the coupled-trajectory estimator for UGC increments—that last piece is what turns the theory into an actionable scheduler. Budget 1–1.5 hours. Engineering-focused readers can skip proof details and keep the conclusions and estimator form.

recommendation.zh: 把 mask schedule 从启发式变成可由样本估计的数据几何量；做 discrete diffusion LM 的人应看 UGC 定义与 KL 误差界，实证收益仍待验证。
recommendation.en: Turns mask schedules from heuristics into a sample-estimable data-geometry quantity; discrete diffusion LM researchers should study the UGC definition and KL bounds, but empirical gains remain unverified.

paper.title: Local verification cannot detect non-transportability: a cohomological theory of context preservation in agentic reasoning
paper.abstract: Agentic AI systems routinely transport conclusions across biological, clinical and financial contexts, and the emerging safeguard is local verification: checking at each step that the entity is representable in the chosen tool, that parameters are compatible, and that outputs cohere with the plan. We prove this class of safeguard is structurally incomplete. Modelling a covering of context space by its nerve and evidence by a real-valued 1-cochain, an agent chaining evidence performs path integra

summary.core_problem: 使用工具的 agent 在跨上下文迁移结论时（如跨人群、跨实验条件、跨商业场景套用一条证据），常见的安全机制是局部验证：每一步检查实体是否被当前工具覆盖、参数是否兼容、输出是否符合计划。论文要回答的是这类局部验证在原理上能发现哪些错误、不能发现哪些错误。
summary.importance: 对预训练/基座研究的直接关联较弱，但对 agentic reasoning 和长链路工具使用的可靠性分析有理论价值。核心结论是不可能性型的：每一步的局部检查合起来仍然无法发现一种结构性错误——沿不同推理路径汇总证据时结论会路径依赖，而每一步的局部一致性全部成立。这对理解长上下文、长链路推理中“局部正确但全局错误”的失效模式有启发，也和多步推理中的一致性、verifier 设计、长视野 agent 评估相关。离预训练主问题较远，更偏 agent 可靠性理论。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把上下文空间建模为拓扑空间 X，用一组邻域 U_i 作开覆盖；覆盖的神经复形 N(U) 的顶点是上下文，边是两个上下文的可桥接人群/子群，三角形是三者交集。证据被建模为 1-上链 ω：每条边 ij 上存放两个上下文之间在交叠群体上测得的对比量。Agent 沿路径“运输”结论对应做路径积分。核心定理给出：结论路径无关当且仅当 ω 是恰当上链（存在全局 0-上链 θ 使 ω=δθ）；不同路径之间的歧义正好是第一 Čech 上同调类 H¹ 中的和乐/绕异性。通过 Hodge 分解，证据冲突被拆为三部分：coboundary（可通过重标定解决）、coexact（需重新测量）、harmonic（局部检查完全不可见，唯一的修复是细化上下文覆盖本身）。基于此设计了 Kṣetra：对上同调分量做投影估计，用 harmonic 分量触发弃权，并把冲突分流为 recalibrate / re-measure / refine 三类动作。
summary.experiments: 实验部分构造了 2400 个 context-transport 问题，分布在两个结构不同的域上：一个是可收缩属性空间（原则上不存在拓扑阻碍），一个是商业周期类的圆周属性空间（构造性地存在非平凡和乐）。论文声称局部验证方法在后者上会通过所有 stepwise check，但结论随路径变化；基于上同调的 gating 能识别这种不可传输性，并给出了在 harm:benefit 阈值之上启用 cohomological gating 的决策经济学分析。实验是概念验证性质，规模较小，重点在于理论构造而非大规模基准。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看 Introduction 中与 Medea 架构和 network meta-analysis 的 loop inconsistency 的对应，以及 Theory 部分的定理陈述（Theorem 5、Theorem 7、Corollary 9、Proposition 12）和 Hodge 三分的操作性含义。具体的上同调计算细节和商业决策经济学部分可以跳过。预计阅读时间 30–40 分钟，需要一点代数拓扑/上同调的基础知识；如果不熟悉 Čech cohomology，只需抓住“存在一种局部检查永远看不到的全局环路不一致”这一点即可。

summary_en.core_problem: Tool-using agents routinely transport conclusions across contexts — across populations, experimental conditions, or business settings. Standard safeguards rely on local verification: checking at each step that entities are representable in the chosen tool, that parameters are compatible, and that outputs cohere with the plan. The paper asks a sharp theoretical question: what class of failures can such local checks detect, and what class is structurally invisible to them?
summary_en.importance: The paper is tangential to core pretraining but relevant to the reliability of agentic reasoning and long-horizon tool use. Its main contribution is an impossibility result: even if every local check passes, a conclusion can still depend on the particular reasoning path an agent took through the evidence, because of a global topological obstruction. This is a useful lens on 'locally correct, globally wrong' failures in long-context and multi-step reasoning, verifier design, and agent evaluation. It sits at some distance from the main pretraining agenda and is best treated as theory for agent reliability rather than as a training-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors model the space of decision-relevant situations as a topological space X, and a collection of contexts as an open cover {U_i}. Evidence on how a quantity contrasts between two contexts is represented as a real-valued 1-cochain ω on the nerve of the cover: an edge stores the contrast estimated on the overlapping population shared by two contexts, a triangle records the 3-way consistency condition. An agent transporting a claim across a chain of contexts is then performing path integration of this cochain. The core theorem states that conclusions are path-independent if and only if ω is exact (i.e., ω = δθ for some global assignment θ on vertices), and that disagreement between different paths is exactly the holonomy of the first Čech cohomology class [ω] ∈ H¹. Hodge decomposition splits evidence conflict into three orthogonal pieces: coboundary (fixable by recalibration), coexact (requires re-measurement), and harmonic (invisible to every local check; only remediable by refining the cover itself). This yields Kṣetra, a method that estimates the cochain components, gates abstention on the harmonic part, and triages conflicts into recalibrate / re-measure / refine actions.
summary_en.experiments: A controlled study is run on 2,400 context-transport problems in two structurally different domains: one with a contractible attribute space (no topological obstruction by construction) and one whose attribute space is a circle (the business cycle, constructed to carry non-trivial holonomy). The paper reports that local-verification style safeguards pass every stepwise check in the circular setting while still producing path-dependent conclusions, whereas cohomological gating detects non-transportability and triggers abstention or refinement. A decision-economics analysis sketches the harm:benefit threshold above which cohomological gating pays for its cost. The experiments are conceptual and small-scale; the contribution is primarily the theory rather than an empirical benchmark showing at-scale gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Prioritize the Introduction (especially the connection to Medea and loop inconsistency in network meta-analysis) and the theorem statements in the Theory section (Theorem 5, Theorem 7, Corollary 9, Proposition 12), focusing on the operational meaning of the three Hodge components. The cohomological computation details and the decision-economics section can be skipped. Reading time: 30–40 minutes. Some familiarity with Čech cohomology helps; if the technical machinery is heavy, the durable message is simply that global loop inconsistencies are structurally undetectable by purely local stepwise checks.

recommendation.zh: 用 Čech 上同调论证 agent 局部验证的不完备，理论干净但离预训练实践远；看 §3 的 Hodge 分解和主定理即可，当机制分析的弱信号。
recommendation.en: A clean cohomological argument that local agent verification is structurally incomplete; far from pretraining practice—read the Hodge decomposition and main theorem as a weak mechanistic signal.

paper.title: Intrinsic Structure: Spectral Identifiability for Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability explains models by identifying circuits inside them, but has no way to tell whether a circuit is a property of the model or an artifact of the method that found it. Sparse autoencoders illustrate the problem: different seeds and widths recover materially different features from the same activations, and no theory says whether that variability is incidental or structural. We put dictionary learning for interpretability on an identifiability footing. Treating the forwa

summary.core_problem: 机制可解释性领域（稀疏自编码器SAE、transcoder、因果干预等）缺少可识别性理论基础：无法判断发现的「回路/特征」是模型本身的固有属性，还是由搜索方法、随机种子、超参数带来的人工产物；SAE在相同激活上不同种子/宽度得到显著不同的特征，现有范式没有定理保证恢复出的结构是模型不变量。
summary.importance: 首次把Transformer前向传播形式化为「深度为时间、注意力跨token写入为控制输入、MLP为自治非线性动力学」的受控离散动力系统，引入Koopman算子得到坐标无关的谱不变量，并证明其有限样本可识别性，为机制可解释性提供了一个不依赖字典基的、可证唯一的基准对象；同时严格证明了SAE目标本身不具备可识别性，解释了其运行间不稳定的根源。对预训练研究员的价值在于：提供了一种跨层、跨训练运行比较模型内在结构的理论工具，可用于分析训练动态、结构涌现、不同预训练配方对内部计算的影响。
summary.technical_approach: 1）将固定token位置上第ℓ层残差流状态x_ℓ视为状态，将其他token位置对该位置的注意力写入收集为外生控制u_ℓ，把前向传播重写为深度递推的受控离散动力系统：x_{ℓ+1}=x_ℓ + a_ℓ(x_ℓ,u_ℓ) + m_ℓ(x_ℓ + a_ℓ(x_ℓ,u_ℓ))，其中a为注意力子层、m为MLP子层。2）引入作用于可观测量ψ的Koopman算子K，通过复合动力学演化可观测量；尽管原动力学非线性，K在可观测量空间是线性的。3）若字典Ψ张成K的不变子空间，则K限制为有限矩阵A，其特征对定义为Transformer的Koopman模态，整个框架称为Koopman谱分析（KSA）；A的特征值在字典基变换下不变，仅相差排列。4）使用带控制的扩展动态模态分解（EDMDc）从M个校准样本估计该谱，主定理证明以M^{-1/2}的参数速率可恢复谱（不计排列与重数简并），并给出无间隙加强、聚类谱扩展、最小最大下界、重尾分布变体等一系列理论结果。5）进一步证明模态-主成分解离性质，以及SAE目标（单层激活重构+稀疏）的代数不完备性与不可识别性。
summary.experiments: 在3个预训练模型上完成系统测量，实验部分核心是验证：1）Koopman谱在不同字典基、不同采样下的稳定性与可复现性；2）谱估计误差随样本量M的衰减符合M^{-1/2}的理论预测；3）与SAE特征的对比：SAE特征随种子/宽度显著漂移，而Koopman谱是跨运行稳定的不变量；4）模态-主成分解离的定量验证，展示KSA提取的结构与普通PCA捕获的统计方向有本质区别。（注：原文第11节给出完整测量，摘要部分未列出具体模型规模与数值指标，精读时需关注该节的定量误差曲线与跨运行一致性数字。）
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计40–60分钟，理论背景强的读者可延长。建议路径：1）先读第1、3节，掌握「深度=时间、注意力=控制」的建模视角，这是全文最核心的概念转换；2）第4节快速过EDMDc估计器和三个假设的内容，不必陷入证明细节；3）第6、7、9节抓定理结论：有限样本可识别速率、最小最大下界、SAE不可识别性——这是对预训练研究最有信息量的部分；4）第11节实验看谱稳定性和与SAE的对比图；5）若不做可解释性理论，第5、8、10节的长证明可跳过。值得深挖的点：如何把该谱不变量用作预训练训练动态的探针（不同数据阶段/优化器/架构下谱如何演化），以及能否与loss spike、涌现能力建立关联。

summary_en.core_problem: Mechanistic interpretability (sparse autoencoders, transcoders, causal intervention, etc.) lacks a foundation in identifiability theory. There is no way to determine whether a discovered circuit or feature is an intrinsic property of the trained model or an artifact of the recovery method, random seed, or hyperparameters. SAEs consistently recover materially different features from the same activations across seeds and widths, and no existing paradigm provides a theorem guaranteeing that the recovered structure is a model invariant.
summary_en.importance: This work formalizes the Transformer forward pass as a controlled discrete dynamical system where depth acts as time, cross-token attention writes act as control inputs, and MLPs act as autonomous nonlinear dynamics. It introduces the Koopman operator to yield coordinate-free spectral invariants and proves their finite-sample identifiability, supplying mechanistic interpretability with a provably unique, basis-independent reference object. It also rigorously shows that the SAE objective itself is non-identifiable, explaining the source of run-to-run instability. For pretraining research, the framework provides a theoretical tool for comparing intrinsic model structure across layers and across training runs, usable for analyzing training dynamics, structural emergence, and how pretraining recipes shape internal computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) At a fixed token position, treat the residual-stream state x_ℓ at layer ℓ as the state and collect attention writes from other token positions as exogenous controls u_ℓ. The forward pass is rewritten as a depth-indexed controlled recurrence: x_{ℓ+1}=x_ℓ + a_ℓ(x_ℓ,u_ℓ) + m_ℓ(x_ℓ + a_ℓ(x_ℓ,u_ℓ)), where a is the attention sublayer and m the MLP sublayer. 2) Introduce the Koopman operator K acting on observables ψ by composition with the dynamics; although the original dynamics are nonlinear, K is linear on the space of observables. 3) If a dictionary Ψ spans an invariant subspace of K, then K restricts to a finite matrix A whose eigenpairs are defined as the Transformer's Koopman modes; the overall framework is called Koopman Spectral Analysis (KSA). The eigenvalues of A are invariant under dictionary basis changes, up to permutation. 4) Use Extended Dynamic Mode Decomposition with control (EDMDc) to estimate the spectrum from M calibration samples. The main theorem establishes recoverability at the parametric rate M^{-1/2}, modulo permutation and multiplicity degeneracies, with extensions including a gap-free strengthening, clustered-spectrum case, minimax lower bound, and heavy-tailed variant. 5) Further results prove a modal–principal dissociation property and the algebraic incompleteness / non-identifiability of the SAE objective (single-layer reconstruction + sparsity).
summary_en.experiments: Systematic measurements are reported on three pretrained models. The experimental section validates: 1) Stability and reproducibility of the Koopman spectrum across dictionary bases and sampling procedures. 2) That spectral estimation error decays with sample size M at the theoretically predicted M^{-1/2} rate. 3) A direct comparison with SAEs: SAE features drift substantially across seeds and widths, whereas the Koopman spectrum is a stable cross-run invariant. 4) Quantitative verification of the modal–principal dissociation, showing that the structure captured by KSA is fundamentally distinct from the statistical directions recovered by ordinary PCA. (Full quantitative curves and cross-run consistency numbers are detailed in Section 11.)
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, roughly 40–60 minutes; longer for readers with strong theory interests. Suggested path: 1) Start with Sections 1 and 3 to internalize the modeling shift: depth = time, attention = control. This is the central conceptual contribution. 2) Skim Section 4 for the EDMDc estimator and the three standing assumptions, without dwelling on proof mechanics. 3) In Sections 6, 7, and 9, focus on the theorem statements: finite-sample identifiability rate, minimax lower bound, and SAE non-identifiability — these carry the most information for pretraining research. 4) In Section 11, inspect the spectral-stability plots and SAE-comparison figures. 5) Skip the long proofs in Sections 5, 8, and 10 unless working on interpretability theory directly. Promising follow-up directions include using spectral invariants as probes for pretraining training dynamics (how spectra evolve across data phases, optimizers, or architectures) and linking them to loss spikes or emergent capabilities.

recommendation.zh: 做 mech interp 的人该看：它不是又一个 feature atlas，而是在问“你找到的东西是否可辨识”；先看理论设定和 recoverability 结论，别急着信实验包装。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about mech interp rigor: it asks whether discovered structure is identifiable at all, not just visually plausible; focus on the theorem setup before trusting the empirical story.

paper.title: The Tamed Subgradient Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm beyond Convexity
paper.abstract: We study the problem of sampling from target distributions whose potentials are simultaneously non-smooth, subject to superlinear gradient growth, and non-convex. We introduce the Subgradient Tamed Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm (SG-TULA), a discretisation of the Langevin diffusion that operates directly on subgradients, without relying on computationally demanding smoothing procedures. To handle the superlinear regime, taming techniques are employed to produce a stable, explicit scheme. We deriv

summary.core_problem: 解决非凸、非光滑且梯度超线性增长目标下，基于 Langevin 的采样/优化方法难以稳定工作的理论与算法问题，并尝试连接到 GPT-2 风格预训练目标。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是优化理论与采样算法：提出可处理 subgradient 和 superlinear growth 的 SG-TULA，并给出显式非渐近收敛界。对 LLM 预训练的价值在于它把一个更接近实际正则化预训练势函数的目标纳入可分析框架，但离主流大规模训练 recipe 仍有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Subgradient Tamed Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm，在离散 Langevin 更新中直接使用次梯度，并通过 taming 机制抑制超线性梯度导致的不稳定；同时给出 Wasserstein-2 收敛界和 excess risk 界。论文还验证 GPT-2 谱系的正则化预训练势函数满足其假设，并讨论 boosted coordinate-wise 变体。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出标准 LLM 规模实验细节，只说明在 GPT-2 lineage 的 regularized pretraining potential 上验证假设，并称 boosted coordinate-wise SG-TULA 可预训练。若正文没有大规模对照，这更像理论可行性展示，而非可直接迁移到生产训练的 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses stable sampling/optimization for objectives that are simultaneously non-convex, non-smooth, and have superlinear gradient growth, with an eye toward GPT-2-like pretraining potentials.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is in optimization theory and sampling algorithms: SG-TULA handles subgradients and superlinear growth with explicit non-asymptotic guarantees. Its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect but nontrivial because it analyzes a regime closer to realistic regularized pretraining objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces the Subgradient Tamed Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm, which directly uses subgradients in a Langevin discretization and applies taming to stabilize updates under superlinear gradients. It derives Wasserstein-2 convergence bounds and excess-risk guarantees, and checks the assumptions for a GPT-2-lineage regularized pretraining potential.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report standard large-scale LLM training experiments. It mainly claims assumption verification for GPT-2-like objectives and pretraining with a boosted coordinate-wise SG-TULA variant, so the empirical value likely depends on whether the paper includes convincing optimization comparisons.

recommendation.zh: 偏理论，离主流 AdamW 训练很远；但若你在想非平滑正则、采样式优化或 loss spike 稳定性，先看假设验证那节再决定要不要深读。
recommendation.en: Theory-heavy and far from mainstream AdamW training, but worth checking the assumption-verification section if you care about nonsmooth regularization or sampling-style stabilization.

paper.title: Optimal Training-Time Scaling in Gradual Adaptation
paper.abstract: In gradual adaptation, how should the training time on each task change as the number of intermediate tasks increases? We study this question for overparameterized linear regression tasks that change smoothly and share a zero-loss solution. With $N$ tasks and training time $s_N$ on each, the final learning progress converges to a continuum curve when $Ns_N\toτ$. The limiting progress is $Θ(τ)$ for small $τ$ and $Θ(τ^{-1})$ for large $τ$, so both very short and very long training produce little p

summary.core_problem: 研究渐进式适应中，当中间任务数量增加时，每个任务应该训练多久，才能让最终任务上的学习进展最大。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个训练时间分配的 scaling 结论，虽然建立在过参数线性回归和小规模视觉/时间漂移实验上，但问题与 continual pretraining、课程学习和领域平滑迁移有概念接口。
summary.technical_approach: 论文考虑一系列平滑变化、共享零损失解的过参数线性回归任务。设中间任务数为 N、每个任务训练时间为 s_N，证明当 N s_N 收敛到 τ 时，最终学习进展收敛到连续曲线；该曲线在小 τ 下为 Θ(τ)，大 τ 下为 Θ(τ^{-1})，由此推出最优 per-task 时间 s_N* = Θ(N^{-1})。
summary.experiments: 理论结论用逐渐旋转的 MNIST 和自然 Yearbook 时间漂移任务做一致性验证。实验表明，当路径被切得更细时，每个中间任务应减少训练时间。没有 LLM 规模实验，也没有预训练损失或 downstream LM 指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how much training time should be spent on each task in gradual adaptation as the number of intermediate tasks increases.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a scaling result for training-time allocation. Although derived for overparameterized linear regression and checked on small visual/time-shift tasks, the question is conceptually relevant to continual pretraining, curricula, and smooth domain transfer.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis studies smoothly changing overparameterized linear regression tasks that share a zero-loss solution. With N tasks and per-task training time s_N, the final learning progress converges to a continuum curve when N s_N approaches τ. The limiting progress scales as Θ(τ) for small τ and Θ(τ^{-1}) for large τ, implying an optimal per-task schedule s_N* = Θ(N^{-1}).
summary_en.experiments: The empirical checks use gradually rotated MNIST and a natural Yearbook time-shift setting. The results are consistent with spending less training time per intermediate task as the adaptation path is divided more finely. There are no LLM-scale experiments or language-model pretraining metrics.

recommendation.zh: 可作 continual pretrain 日程的弱理论先验；只看定理主线和 MNIST/Yearbook 是否支持 Θ(1/N)。
recommendation.en: A weak theoretical prior for continual-pretraining schedules; read only the theorem path and whether MNIST/Yearbook really support the Θ(1/N) rule.

paper.title: Relational Response Fields: A General Theory of Black-Box LLM Response Consistency and Recovery
paper.abstract: Black-box language-model reliability is commonly pursued by sampling, prompting, voting, verifying, or iteratively revising individual answers. We ask a prior question: \emph{what determines whether a collection of black-box responses is recoverable at all?} We represent responses to typed transformations of a query as a \emph{relational response field} (RRF). Edge transports encode how valid responses must change under paraphrase, scaling, decomposition, refactoring, or other task symmetries; a

summary.core_problem: 给定一组黑盒 LLM 在变换后查询上的响应，什么时候这些响应在存在部分错误时仍然可被唯一恢复。
summary.importance: 这是一个偏理论的机制分析工作，贡献在于把 response consistency、self-consistency、verifier/anchor 等经验做法抽象成统一可恢复性框架，并给出可识别条件、稳定性界和 minimax 下界。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Relational Response Field（RRF）：把不同查询变换下的回答视为图上的节点，边表示在 paraphrase、decomposition、refactoring、scaling 等关系下合法答案应如何传输变化，anchor 表示外部可信证据如执行器或 verifier。定义关系算子 D、anchor 算子 A 及至多 k 个污染节点时的难度量 γ_k(D,A)，并证明 γ_k>0 当且仅当任意 k 节点污染可识别，同时给出与 1/γ_k 成正比的稳定性上界及匹配的 minimax 下界。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调理论结果，没有给出明确的大规模实证设置、模型规模或标准 benchmark。更像是统一解释框架，而非直接提升某个 LLM 系统指标的工程论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自成均馆大学（Sungkyunkwan University）。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when a collection of black-box LLM responses under query transformations is recoverable in the presence of corrupted answers.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a theory/analysis contribution. It abstracts response consistency, self-consistency, verifier-based checking, and revision into a unified recoverability framework, then derives identifiability conditions, stability bounds, and matching minimax lower bounds.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author introduces Relational Response Fields (RRFs), where responses to transformed queries are nodes in a graph. Edges encode how valid answers should transform under paraphrase, decomposition, refactoring, scaling, and related symmetries; anchors encode trusted external evidence such as execution or verification. For relation operator D, anchor operator A, and up to k corrupted nodes, the paper defines γ_k(D,A) and proves that γ_k>0 iff every k-node corruption is identifiable, with stability scaling as 1/γ_k and a matching minimax lower bound.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract is theory-heavy and does not provide a concrete large-scale empirical setup, model sizes, or benchmark results. It reads more like a unifying analytical framework than an engineering paper that directly improves LLM performance.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with Sungkyunkwan University.

recommendation.zh: 偏抽象，离 pretrain 很远；如果你在做 verifier/self-consistency，这篇可当统一语言，但先别把它当可直接落地的 recipe。
recommendation.en: Quite abstract and far from pretraining; useful as a unifying lens for verifier or self-consistency work, but not something to treat as an immediately actionable recipe.

paper.title: Hierarchical Solomonoff Induction: An Unbounded Machine Learning Model
paper.abstract: Solomonoff Induction, or SolInd, provides an ideal unbounded model of a priori sequence prediction but cannot naturally describe extrapolation from a given training dataset, as performed by Large Language Models. We apply de Finetti's theorem on exchangeable distributions to SolInd to produce what we call Hierarchical Solomonoff Induction, or HSI, which maintains a hyperprior over all Solomonoff priors that can be conditioned on previously observed sequences.   We extend Wood et al.'s proof that

summary.core_problem: 从理论上解释 Solomonoff Induction 如何描述类似 LLM 的“先看训练集、再对新序列外推”的学习过程。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是序列预测和归纳理论分析。它与 LLM 的联系是概念层面的：把训练集条件化问题写成对 Solomonoff priors 的超先验，而不是给出现代神经语言模型的可操作训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 利用 de Finetti 关于 exchangeable distributions 的定理，构造 Hierarchical Solomonoff Induction：在所有 Solomonoff priors 之上维护 hyperprior，并可用已观测序列进行条件化；随后扩展 Wood et al. 对 universal mixtures of semimeasures 与 SolInd 等价性的证明，证明 universal mixtures of mixtures 仍等价于 SolInd，即 HSI=SolInd。
summary.experiments: 这是理论论文，摘要没有经验实验。主要结果包括：HSI 相对真实生成器的 excess error 被该生成器在 hyperprior 中的复杂度界定，并迫使平均 excess error 收敛；该界与经典 SolInd 中由序列 Kolmogorov complexity 控制预测误差的形式对应。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how Solomonoff Induction can describe the LLM-like pattern of conditioning on a training dataset and then extrapolating to new sequences.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is theoretical sequence-prediction analysis. Its connection to LLMs is conceptual: it formulates dataset conditioning via a hyperprior over Solomonoff priors, rather than offering an actionable training method for neural language models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using de Finetti's theorem for exchangeable distributions, it defines Hierarchical Solomonoff Induction with a hyperprior over all Solomonoff priors that can be conditioned on observed sequences. It then extends Wood et al.'s equivalence proof for universal mixtures of semimeasures and proves that universal mixtures of mixtures are still equivalent to SolInd, i.e. HSI=SolInd.
summary_en.experiments: This is a theoretical paper with no empirical experiments in the abstract. The main result bounds HSI's excess error relative to the true generator by that generator's complexity under the hyperprior, paralleling the classic SolInd bound based on Kolmogorov complexity.

recommendation.zh: 理论味很重，实际 recipe 为零；若关心“训练集条件化是否改变通用归纳器”这个 prior，可读证明主线。
recommendation.en: This is theory-heavy with no training recipe; read the proof sketch only if you care whether dataset conditioning changes the universal induction story.

paper.title: Guarantees on Dynamical System Distinguishability for LLM Token Generation
paper.abstract: Recent work has shown that classifying large language models (LLMs)' responses can be distinguished by modeling token embeddings as trajectories of a black-box dynamical system (DS) and comparing prediction residuals of two DSs. Despite the empirical success of this dynamical approach, a theoretical understanding of why it works, how well it scales as a function of the token sequence, and when it transfers across embedding models remains lacking. We address these questions by formalizing the cla

summary.core_problem: 给“把 LLM token embedding 视作动力系统轨迹来区分模型输出”这一思路提供理论保证，并刻画其随序列长度的可分性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是理论分析。它不直接改进预训练，但对理解 token 动态中哪些信息超出静态分布、以及为什么长序列能放大模型差异，有一定机制层面的参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把分类问题形式化为两个随机线性动力系统之间的二元假设检验。核心结论有两点：一是若只看平稳边缘分布，即使两个系统动力学差异很大，总变差距离也可任意小，因此忽略时序动态的分类器存在准确率下界；二是基于动力系统残差的分类错误率会随序列长度 L 指数衰减，衰减率由系统参数决定。文中还讨论了跨 embedding 模型迁移何时成立。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，重点在理论推导而非大规模实证。没有看到与主流 LLM 预训练设置、参数规模或训练数据相关的系统实验；更像是对已有经验现象的解释框架。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper provides theoretical guarantees for distinguishing LLM-generated token sequences by modeling embeddings as trajectories of dynamical systems.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a theory/analysis contribution. It does not advance pretraining directly, but it offers some mechanistic insight into what temporal token dynamics capture beyond static marginals and why longer sequences improve separability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors cast the task as binary hypothesis testing between two stochastic linear dynamical systems. Two main results follow: classifiers that ignore dynamics can hit a fundamental accuracy floor because stationary marginals may be arbitrarily close even when dynamics differ, while DS-based classification error decays exponentially with sequence length L, with the exponent governed by system parameters. The paper also discusses transfer across embedding models.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the emphasis is on theory rather than large-scale empirical study. There is no indication of substantial experiments tied to mainstream LLM pretraining regimes, model scales, or data mixtures.

recommendation.zh: 偏理论，离 pretrain 主线较远；若你关心 token dynamics 是否携带超出静态分布的信息，只看定理结论和误差指数衰减那部分即可。
recommendation.en: Theory-heavy and somewhat off the main pretraining path; read only if you care whether token dynamics carry signal beyond static marginals.

paper.title: Indexing: the Beginning and the End
paper.abstract: We study information bottlenecks in modern deep-learning architectures -- RNNs, softmax transformers, linear-attention transformers and state-space models -- through the lens of the indexing primitive. In this primitive, the input consists of $n$ bits and one integer $i$ from $1$ to $n$ called the index, and the output equals the value of the $i$-th bit.   We introduce causal complexity for masked architectures. We show that architectures with low causal complexity cannot solve the indexing prim

summary.core_problem: 用 indexing 这个最小原语刻画不同序列架构的信息瓶颈，解释哪些模型在因果掩码下难以完成远程内容读取。
summary.importance: 这是机制与理论分析工作。价值不在于直接给出新模型，而在于把 RNN、SSM、softmax attention、linear attention 的能力差异压缩到一个干净任务上，能帮助理解为何某些高效架构在语言建模里会掉点。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 masked architecture 的 causal complexity 概念，并分析当索引 token 出现在序列末尾或开头时，不同架构在常数层数下能否实现 indexing。结论是：低 causal complexity 的 RNN、SSM、masked linear attention 在“索引位于末尾”时受限；小型 softmax Transformer 一层可解，非 masked linear attention 两层可解；而“索引位于开头”时，小型 RNN 一层即可完成。
summary.experiments: 核心是理论分离结果而非大规模训练实验。比较对象覆盖 RNN、softmax Transformer、linear-attention Transformer、SSM；结果给出按输入布局区分的表达能力边界。对 LLM 的启发在于：因果掩码与状态压缩共同决定了检索型计算是否容易实现。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies information bottlenecks in sequence architectures through the indexing primitive, asking which models can retrieve the indexed bit under causal masking.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/theory paper. Its value is not a new model, but a clean separation showing why RNNs, SSMs, softmax attention, and linear attention differ on retrieval-like computations relevant to language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces causal complexity for masked architectures and analyzes whether different models can solve indexing when the index token appears at the end versus the beginning of the sequence. It shows that low-causal-complexity RNNs, SSMs, and masked linear-attention transformers fail in constant depth when the index is at the end; small softmax transformers solve it in one layer, and unmasked linear attention in two. When the index is at the beginning, small RNNs can solve it in one layer.
summary_en.experiments: The contribution is primarily theoretical rather than large-scale empirical training. The comparison spans RNNs, softmax transformers, linear-attention transformers, and SSMs, yielding architecture-dependent expressivity boundaries conditioned on token order.

recommendation.zh: 这类 paper 不会直接改 recipe，但会改你对 SSM/linear attention 失分来源的 prior；重点看 indexing-at-end 的分离结论。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your recipe tomorrow, but it should update your prior on where SSM/linear-attention losses come from; focus on the indexing-at-end separation.

paper.title: Position: Natural Language Should Not Fully Replace Formal Languages
paper.abstract: Recent advances in large language models and their widespread adoption have prompted claims that natural language could entirely replace formal languages, such as programming languages for software design. In this position paper, we argue that this perspective overlooks fundamental linguistic properties of natural language, specifically that it is optimized for underspecification in open-ended contexts. We introduce a formal framework centered on *task specificity*, defining it as the informatio

summary.core_problem: 讨论自然语言是否能够在高规格约束任务中完全替代形式语言，并试图给出一个可分析的边界条件。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是立场论文加理论框架。它不直接提出新模型或训练方法，但对代码生成、图像生成提示、形式化接口设计这些与 LLM 使用边界相关的问题给出较清晰的概念化。
summary.technical_approach: 论文引入 task specificity 概念，将其定义为用户需求对输出空间不确定性的压缩量，并提出 specificity crossover theorem：当任务规格超过某个阈值时，用自然语言表达形式约束的成本会高于直接使用形式语言。随后用代码、图像、音频等案例做论证。
summary.experiments: 这不是实验型论文，核心证据来自理论论证与案例分析，而非大规模 benchmark。没有模型参数、训练数据或标准 baseline 对比，因此更适合作为观点材料而非实证依据。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether natural language can fully replace formal languages in high-specificity tasks, and tries to characterize the boundary analytically.
summary_en.importance: This is a position paper with a theoretical framing. It does not introduce a new model or training method, but it offers a useful lens on the limits of NL interfaces for code, image prompting, and formal task specification.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces task specificity as the information-theoretic reduction of uncertainty over an output space induced by user requirements, and states a specificity crossover theorem: beyond a threshold, expressing formal requirements in natural language becomes more costly than using a formal language directly. It then argues through case studies in code, image, and audio generation.
summary_en.experiments: This is not an empirical paper. The evidence comes from theoretical argument and illustrative case studies rather than benchmark-driven evaluation. There are no model scales, training datasets, or standard baselines.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但对“自然语言接口能走多远”这个 prior 有清理作用；看定义和 theorem 即可，别指望实证。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it usefully sharpens the limits of NL interfaces; read the definition and theorem, not for empirical evidence.

paper.title: Semantic Field Theory: Historical Origin, Higher-Order Interaction, and Stabilized Semantic Inference
paper.abstract: Semantic Field Theory (SFT) has developed from a philosophical critique of strong anti-formalist readings of language games into a proposed computational model class for lexical semantics, higher order composition, and stabilized interpretation. This paper reconstructs that evolution and gives SFT a sharper mathematical core suitable for independent evaluation in computational linguistics and representation learning. The central proposal is that a tractable level of linguistic organization can b

summary.core_problem: 尝试把 Semantic Field Theory 形式化为一种可计算的词汇语义与高阶组合模型，用语义场、上下文形变和能量稳定来描述解释过程。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是理论形式化。它和 energy-based interpretation、表示学习、组合语义有一定概念邻接，但摘要未显示它能直接改进 LLM 预训练目标、架构或评测，因此对基座研究员是低优先级背景材料。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把语义场模型定义为一个包含语义空间、词汇场提升、上下文形变映射、交互复形和解释泛函的数学元组；同时引入 token 子集上的 interaction terms 和由 semantic energy dynamics 控制的解释稳定机制。整体更像原创理论框架，而非对现有 Transformer/LM 训练方法的直接改造。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调形式定义和证明，没有给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline 或下游实验结果。是否能在表示学习或语言建模中形成可测收益，需要看正文是否有独立实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper formalizes Semantic Field Theory as a computational model of lexical semantics and higher-order composition, using semantic fields, contextual deformation, and energy-based stabilization.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is theoretical formalization. It is conceptually adjacent to energy-based interpretation, representation learning, and compositional semantics, but the abstract does not show a direct impact on LLM pretraining objectives, architectures, or evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed model is defined as a tuple containing a semantic space, a lexical field lifting, a contextual deformation map, an interaction complex, and an interpretation functional. It introduces interaction terms over token subsets and stabilization governed by semantic energy dynamics. The work reads as an original theoretical framework rather than a direct modification of Transformer or LM training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes definitions and proofs, with no reported model size, training data, baselines, or empirical results. Its practical value for representation learning or language modeling depends on whether the full paper provides independent evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 energy-based 语义建模的背景材料；没有实验前，不应把它纳入预训练路线判断。
recommendation.en: Useful background for energy-style semantic modeling, but without experiments it should not affect pretraining roadmap decisions.

paper.title: TwistedMerge: Certified Higher-Order Diagnostics and Abstention for Model Merging
paper.abstract: Model merging combines independently trained or fine-tuned models, but pairwise alignability does not imply globally consistent alignment. We formulate merging as a finite descent problem in which checkpoints are local objects, alignment maps are transitions, and cycle products are residuals. TwistedMerge is a conservative certification pipeline that separates fixed-chart averaging, synchronization-removable gauge inconsistency, a certified central obstruction on a specified comparison complex,

summary.core_problem: 诊断 model merging 中 pairwise alignment 看似可行但多模型全局合并不一致的问题，并在无法认证时选择 abstention。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型合并的理论诊断框架。它关注 checkpoint alignment 的高阶一致性，对多微调模型合并、adapter 合并和模型 soup 的可靠性有间接参考，但离 LLM 预训练主线较远。
summary.technical_approach: 把模型合并表述为有限下降问题：checkpoint 是局部对象，alignment map 是 transition，cycle product 是 residual。TwistedMerge 依次区分固定坐标平均、可由同步消除的 gauge inconsistency、中心阻碍和非交换 holonomy，并在 inverse-consistency、coefficient-identification、centrality、closure 测试不通过时 abstain。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到证明了 constant-edge no-go result、三模型 frozen-complex 和预声明族的误差控制定理，以及 comparison-complex sensitivity 的 refinement test；实验上用 planted neural alignment defect 展示 cycle-consistent synchronization 可移除缺陷。未给出 LLM 规模实验或标准 benchmark 结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper diagnoses cases where pairwise alignment appears valid for model merging but fails to yield globally consistent multi-model alignment, with abstention when certification fails.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a theoretical diagnostic framework for model merging. It is indirectly relevant to merging fine-tuned checkpoints, adapters, or model soups, but it is not central to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Model merging is formulated as a finite descent problem: checkpoints are local objects, alignment maps are transitions, and cycle products are residuals. TwistedMerge separates fixed-chart averaging, synchronization-removable gauge inconsistency, certified central obstruction, and nonabelian holonomy, promoting residuals only after inverse-consistency, coefficient-identification, centrality, and closure tests.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports constant-edge no-go, error-control theorems for frozen-complex three-way and predeclared families, and a refinement test for comparison-complex sensitivity. A planted neural alignment defect is removed by cycle-consistent synchronization, but no LLM-scale benchmark evidence is described.

recommendation.zh: 数学味很重，实际信号只在“pairwise merge 不保证全局一致”这点；做 checkpoint 合并时可查，不建议投入长读。
recommendation.en: The useful signal is the warning that pairwise mergeability does not imply global consistency; keep it as a reference for checkpoint merging, not a long read.

paper.title: Generalised Bellman recurrence and three dualities in sequential decision-making
paper.abstract: What gives the Bellman equation its form? We show that the recursive properties of optimal value functions follow from three conditions: that the dynamics decomposes through sufficient statistics, that the return decomposes recursively, and that the aggregation of uncertainty is compatible with both. When all three conditions hold on a common state, the Bellman equation arises from their mutual consistency; when one fails, tractability can often be recovered by augmenting the state or by deformi

summary.core_problem: 解释 Bellman 方程为什么具有递归形式，以及在更一般的序贯决策问题中哪些条件保证这种递归可成立。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是理论统一。它把强化学习、控制和决策理论中分散出现的 Bellman 递推、状态充分性、回报递归和不确定性聚合放到同一个构造里，对理解 RL 目标和状态表示有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 generalized Bellman recurrence：要求动力学可通过充分统计量分解、return 可递归分解、不确定性聚合与前两者兼容。三者在同一状态上同时成立时，标准 Bellman 方程出现；某一条件失败时，可通过状态增广，或改变 return / dynamics 的形式恢复可处理性。论文还给出 probability-return、return-aggregation、aggregation-probability 三组对偶关系。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看主要是理论推导与框架统一，没有报告 LLM、RLHF 或大规模实验。评估方式更接近形式化证明和例子分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why the Bellman equation has its recursive form and which structural conditions make Bellman-style recursion possible in general sequential decision-making.
summary_en.importance: This is a theoretical unification contribution. It connects sufficient-state dynamics, recursive returns, and uncertainty aggregation under one construction, which is indirectly relevant to RL objectives and state representations used in post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: It defines a generalized Bellman recurrence based on three compatibility conditions: dynamics must decompose through sufficient statistics, returns must decompose recursively, and uncertainty aggregation must be compatible with both. When all hold on a common state, the Bellman equation follows; when one fails, tractability can be recovered by augmenting the state or deforming the return or dynamics. The same construction yields three dualities among probability, return, and aggregation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates a primarily theoretical paper, with no reported LLM, RLHF, or large-scale empirical results. The validation appears to be through formal derivation and conceptual unification.

recommendation.zh: RL 理论味重；做 RLHF 目标设计可扫 abstract 和定义，别期待能直接改训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Theory-heavy RL; skim the abstract and definitions if you design RLHF objectives, but do not expect an actionable training recipe.

paper.title: Falsification-Based Verification of LLM-Generated Optimization Models: Sound Test Batteries and Their Detection Limits
paper.abstract: Large language models now translate natural-language descriptions of decision problems into solver-ready optimization models, but they fail silently. A generated model often runs and still formulates the wrong problem. This paper develops a theory of falsification-based verification for this setting. Every numeric quantity in the description is a typed slot, and a candidate model is tested only through solver calls on slot-transformed instances; no reference model or label is consulted. From dua

summary.core_problem: LLM生成的优化模型常存在静默错误（能运行但表述错误问题），缺乏无需参考模型的可靠验证方法。
summary.importance: 方法创新与理论贡献，首次提出基于证伪的优化模型验证框架，证明了测试的可靠性（零假阳性），并刻画了检测极限。
summary.technical_approach: 将自然语言描述中的每个数值量视为类型化槽位，通过对槽位变换后的实例调用求解器来测试候选模型，无需参考模型。从对偶性、比较静态、多面体极限论证推导出六类测试：方向、曲率、挤压探测、极限禁止、湮灭、交换。
summary.experiments: 理论证明所有测试都是可靠的（违规即证明不忠实，假阳性率为0）；刻画了规范错误类别的确定性检测条件，证明不存在固定阈值扰动测试能同时满足完备性和可靠性。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-generated optimization models often have silent errors (run correctly but formulate the wrong problem), and there is a lack of reliable verification methods without reference models.
summary_en.importance: Methodological and theoretical innovation proposing the first falsification-based verification framework for optimization models, proving soundness (zero false positives), and characterizing detection limits.
summary_en.technical_approach: Treats each numeric quantity in the natural language description as a typed slot, and tests candidate models only through solver calls on slot-transformed instances, no reference model required. Derives six test classes from duality, comparative statics, and polyhedral limit arguments: direction, curvature, crush probes, prohibitive limits, annihilation, exchange.
summary_en.experiments: Theoretically proves all tests are sound (violations certify unfaithfulness, zero false positive rate); characterizes conditions for certain detection of canonical error classes, and proves no fixed-threshold perturbation tester can be both complete and sound.

recommendation.zh: 优化模型生成的证伪验证理论工作，对代码验证方法有参考价值，仅关注理论结论即可。
recommendation.en: Theoretical work on falsification-based verification of optimization model generation; referenceable for code verification methods, only read theoretical conclusions.

paper.title: Diffusion models recover accurate mixture weights despite score function insensitivity
paper.abstract: Score-based generative models exhibit a puzzling behavior: they often appear to cover all modes of a target multimodal distribution and yet may fail to learn the correct relative mode amplitudes, which can be interpreted as mixture weights. We resolve this apparent paradox by relating the diffusion score matching (DSM) loss to the error in estimating mixture weights from generated samples. We show that, even when the target score is insensitive to mixture weights, generated samples can recover t

summary.core_problem: 解释 score-based diffusion model 为什么在目标 score 对 mixture weight 不敏感时，仍可能从生成样本中恢复正确的混合权重。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型理论分析。它对 diffusion LM 或离散 diffusion 不是直接方法贡献，但对理解 score matching 信号中哪些噪声层携带分布参数有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 diffusion score matching loss 与从生成样本估计 mixture weight 的误差联系起来，提出 diffusion score sensitivity index，衡量 DSM loss 对目标分布参数变化的敏感性。核心观点是：即使低噪声或目标 score 本身对权重不敏感，中间噪声层的 score 仍可能包含足够的权重信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调理论结果，特别是任意维 Gaussian mixture 中 mixture weight 估计误差与 DSSI 控制量同阶。未给出大规模神经网络训练、图像生成或语言生成实验的具体模型规模和数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains how score-based diffusion models can recover accurate mixture weights from samples even when the target score appears insensitive to those weights.
summary_en.importance: This is a theoretical analysis of generative modeling. It is not a direct contribution to diffusion language modeling, but it is relevant to understanding which noise levels carry learnable distributional information.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors relate the diffusion score matching loss to the error of estimating mixture weights from generated samples. They introduce the diffusion score sensitivity index, which measures how much the DSM loss varies under changes in a target parameter. The key mechanism is that intermediate noise levels can encode mixture-weight information even when the target score itself is insensitive.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract focuses on theory, especially Gaussian mixtures in arbitrary dimension, where mixture-weight estimation errors are shown to be of the same order as quantities controlled by DSSI. No large-scale neural diffusion, image, or language experiments are specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion LM 可扫一眼 DSSI 定义；它是理论清障，不会直接改变训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: If you work on diffusion LMs, skim the DSSI definition; this is theory cleanup, not something that changes the training recipe directly.

paper.title: Capability from Access Structure, Not Scale: Lower Bounds and Pre-Registered Tests for Hybrid Sequence Models
paper.abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) holds that as models scale, representations of heterogeneous networks converge toward a shared model of reality. We propose its sequel and boundary, the Capability Convergence Hypothesis (CCH): under a fixed per-token inference budget, representational convergence does not entail capability convergence. Capability instead converges toward a class, the access-complete hybrid: any architecture holding both a compressive O(1)-state channel and a scalable

summary.core_problem: 讨论在固定每 token 推理预算下，为什么表征随规模收敛并不自动带来能力收敛，尤其针对混合序列模型的访问结构限制。
summary.importance: 这是偏理论的架构能力边界分析，试图把“能力来自 scale”改写为“能力来自 access structure”。对做长上下文、混合记忆架构、外部检索/压缩通道的人有概念启发，但离可直接落地的 pretrain recipe 还较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Capability Convergence Hypothesis，定义 access-complete hybrid：同时具备压缩的 O(1) 状态通道和可扩展的 verbatim-index 通道。围绕一个无限流 witness task（Newton's-apple problem）给出三类资源墙：Shannon wall、horizon wall、circuit wall，并在显式可分离假设下论证混合结构能跨越三者，能力呈超加性。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看重点是预注册测试与理论下界，而非大规模实证。没有给出与主流 LLM 在真实预训练设置下的系统比较，更多是概念性分离结果。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks why representational convergence with scale does not imply capability convergence under a fixed per-token inference budget, focusing on access-structure limits in hybrid sequence models.
summary_en.importance: This is a theory-leaning architecture paper that tries to replace a 'capability comes from scale' intuition with 'capability comes from access structure.' It is conceptually useful for long-context, hybrid-memory, and retrieval-style modeling, though still far from an actionable pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes the Capability Convergence Hypothesis and defines an access-complete hybrid: an architecture with both a compressive O(1)-state channel and a scalable verbatim-index channel. Using an infinite-stream witness task (the Newton's-apple problem), it introduces three resource walls—Shannon, horizon, and circuit—and argues, under an explicit separability assumption, that a hybrid can cross all three and yields strictly super-additive capability under composition.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the emphasis is on preregistered tests and lower-bound style arguments rather than large-scale empirical evidence. There is no clear comparison against mainstream LLMs in realistic pretraining regimes.

recommendation.zh: 想做长程记忆或 hybrid LM 可以看它的 framing，但目前更像理论宣言；先读问题设定和三道 wall，别急着接受结论。
recommendation.en: Worth a look if you work on long-memory or hybrid LMs, but it reads more like a theoretical manifesto; read the task setup and the three walls, then stay skeptical.

paper.title: Sharp Stability Threshold and Certification for Designing Stable Residual Architectures
paper.abstract: We propose \emph{the sublinear-growth principle} for deep residual architectures -- a sharp stability threshold on the input-magnitude exponent of every residual block's velocity field: $$\|v(x, t)\| \leq c\,\|x\|^q + b, \qquad q \in [0, 1].$$ The threshold $q = 1$ is established via two independent arguments. Classical ODE theory gives a global forward flow on $[0, T]$ at $q \le 1$ and exhibits divergent velocity fields at any $q > 1$. The optimal-control analysis, via the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellm

summary.core_problem: 研究深层残差架构在训练和推理中何时能保持全局稳定，并给出可验证的结构条件。
summary.importance: 贡献是基础深度学习理论分析：把残差块速度场的输入增长阶数作为稳定性判据，提出 q≤1 的尖锐阈值，并用它解释 layer normalization 等结构为何有稳定作用。对 LLM 预训练的直接贡献有限，但与残差流、归一化和 loss spike 的理论解释有弱关联。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把残差网络视作连续时间 ODE 流，假设每个残差块速度场满足 ||v(x,t)||≤c||x||^q+b。通过经典 ODE 全局存在性证明 q≤1 时前向流安全，q>1 时可构造发散速度场；再用 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman 最优控制分析说明训练最优解会贴近可行域边界，q>1 下最优解可能爆炸。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要呈现理论结果和稳定性认证原则，未给出 LLM 规模实验、Transformer ablation 或预训练动态实验。提到该原则可解释 layer normalization 的稳定化作用，但缺少从摘要可确认的模型规模和基准结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when deep residual architectures admit stable training and inference, and seeks a certifiable architectural condition.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is theoretical: it identifies a sharp growth-exponent threshold for residual velocity fields, q≤1, and connects this condition to the stabilizing role of normalization. The link to LLM pretraining is indirect but relevant to residual dynamics and stability analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors model residual networks as continuous-time ODE flows with velocity growth bounded by ||v(x,t)||≤c||x||^q+b. Classical ODE arguments establish global forward flows for q≤1 and possible divergence for q>1. An optimal-control/HJB analysis further argues that training optima become bang-bang on the admissible boundary, making q>1 unsafe.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes formal analysis rather than large-scale empirical validation. No LLM-scale experiments, Transformer-specific ablations, or pretraining stability measurements are reported in the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 可看作残差稳定性的理论备查；若关心 pretrain loss spike，只扫 q≤1 证明思路即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as a theory reference for residual stability; for pretraining loss spikes, skim only the q≤1 argument.

paper.title: When Is Delegated Play Truthful? Within-Range Regret and the Trilemma of Aligned Delegation
paper.abstract: Advertisers delegate bidding to autobidders; users delegate tasks to language-model agents. A person describes what they want to an automated proxy that acts in a mechanism on their behalf. This is the revelation principle in production, and it forces a question classical theory assumes away: when is it optimal to describe yourself honestly to your own proxy?   We show the answer turns on one quantity, the proxy's within-range regret. The most a principal can gain by misreporting equals the regr

summary.core_problem: 研究当用户把决策委托给代理后，什么时候对自己的代理“如实表达偏好”仍然是最优的，尤其面向自动竞价器和语言模型代理这类 delegated play 场景。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制设计/委托理论工作，不是 LLM 方法论文；它的价值在于给“对齐的代理是否会诱导真实表达”提供了一个可检验条件，对 tool-using agent、elicitation proxy、guardrail 设计有概念层面的约束。
summary.technical_approach: 论文引入 within-range regret 作为核心量，刻画在代理可达动作集合内，诚实报告对应动作相对用户可通过误报诱导出的更优动作之间的差距。主结论是：用户通过误报最多能获得的收益，恰好等于代理在诚实报告下的 within-range regret；因此诚实表达最优，当且仅当代理在其可达范围内已经执行了对用户最优的动作，即论文所称 loyal。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，核心是理论定理而非大规模实证。论文统一解释了 auction autobidding 的已有结果，并把结论连接到 language-model elicitation proxies 的 faithful-communication 假设。未见模型参数、训练数据或标准 ML baseline；更像 formal analysis。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when truthful self-description remains optimal after a user delegates action selection to a proxy, with autobidders and language-model agents as motivating cases.
summary_en.importance: This is not an LLM methods paper but a mechanism-design analysis. Its value for LLM researchers is conceptual: it gives a crisp condition under which aligned delegation preserves truthful elicitation, which matters for tool-using agents and guardrail design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines within-range regret as the gap between the proxy’s action under honest reporting and the best action the principal could have induced via misreporting within the proxy’s reachable action set. The main theorem states that the principal’s gain from misreporting equals this regret. Hence truthful reporting is optimal iff the proxy already chooses the best reachable action for the principal, termed loyalty.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the contribution is primarily theoretical rather than empirical. It unifies prior autobidding results and connects the theorem to the faithful-communication assumption in language-model elicitation proxies. No model scale, training corpus, or ML baselines are indicated.

recommendation.zh: 偏理论但概念很干净：如果你在做 agent alignment 或 elicitation proxy，只需抓住 within-range regret 这一个量；对 pretrain 本身帮助有限，不必细读证明。
recommendation.en: Conceptually clean if you work on agent alignment or elicitation proxies: within-range regret is the one quantity to keep. Limited direct impact on pretraining, so you can skip the proofs.

paper.title: How are linear representations learned? Exact solutions to the dynamics of abstraction
paper.abstract: In artificial and biological neural networks, concepts are often encoded as consistent linear directions in representation space. In deep learning, this idea is known as the linear representation hypothesis and underpins many interpretability and control methods based on linear probes, from concept detection to activation steering. Yet while prior work has studied whether such directions should exist $\textit{after}$ training, the dynamics of how they emerge $\textit{during}$ training remain poo

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是一个比“线性表征是否存在”更前一步的问题：训练过程中，概念方向为什么会逐渐对齐，何时会对齐，何时又会停在明显低于 1 的水平。作者把这个过程称为 abstraction dynamics。在线性表征假说已经被广泛用于 probe、steering、概念检测的背景下，真正缺的不是更多静态证据，而是一个能解释训练轨迹的动力学理论。论文试图回答三件事：数据几何如何决定抽象化速度和上限；网络深度如何改变这一过程；非线性，尤其是 ReLU，为什么常常让表征比线性理论预测得更不抽象。
summary.importance:
它对预训练的直接影响不是 recipe 层面的，而是机制层面的。价值主要体现在三点。第一，它把“抽象表征”从训练终点性质，推进成可解析的训练动力学变量，这对理解表示形成、线性 probe 何时有效、以及为什么某些层更适合 steering 很有帮助。第二，论文给出数据核结构、深度、非线性与 abstraction 之间的明确关系，提供了一个比经验观察更可操作的解释框架。对基座模型研究，这能帮助理解预训练中概念解耦、层间表示演化、以及 probe 泛化失败的来源。第三，作者把理论和现代模型联系起来，不只停在线性网络：他们在 DINOv3 和 Gemma 4 上做了非线性消融，发现去掉非线性后 abstraction 和 probe 泛化都会改善。这一点虽然不是直接的训练改进方案，但对表示工程、可解释性和中间层读写都有启发。

需要控制预期的是：这不是一篇直接告诉你如何把 loss 降得更快的论文。它更像一套关于表示几何形成机制的解析工具。对做大规模预训练的人，价值在于建立判断，而不是立刻改 recipe。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三层推进。

第一层，是最小可解设置下的精确动力学。作者考虑两个二元概念，例如 shape 和 color，对应四个类别，构造出一个具有特定块结构的 dataset kernel，文中称为 2FS。这个设定的好处是，数据几何可以被压缩成少数几类核条目和对应特征模态。在线性网络里，作者把表示分解到若干可解释的方向上，其中关键是“概念主方向”和一个与概念交互相关、会破坏平行性的正交 interaction mode，文中把它视作 noise direction。这样一来，abstraction，也就是不同上下文下概念向量的余弦相似度，就能写成这些模态系数的函数。随后作者求解梯度下降训练下这些模态的完整时间轨迹，从而得到 abstraction 的解析轨迹，而不是只看收敛点。

第二层，是从浅层线性网络推广到任意深度。作者利用深线性网络可解析动力学的工具，推导深度如何改变不同模态的学习速度和相对放大程度。论文的一个核心结论是：深度并不会无条件提高 abstraction，它会通过谱偏置改变各模态的竞争关系，因此最终 abstraction 和训练中达到的最大 abstraction 都受数据谱结构控制。换句话说，深度的作用不是简单“更深更抽象”，而是“更深会重新加权哪些方向先学到、学多快、谁压过谁”。这比很多经验性说法更细。

第三层，是推广到无限宽非线性网络，并分析 feature 与 preactivation 的差异。作者在 NTK/核回归风格的框架下，证明非线性会削弱 feature 中的 abstraction，相比之下 preactivation 更接近线性理论。对 ReLU，作者进一步说明它会重塑动力学，使表示更依赖输入几何而不是目标结构，因此更容易保留或放大 interaction/noise mode，导致抽象化变弱。论文还给出对 tanh 往往比 ReLU 更有利于抽象表征的理论解释，这与先前经验观察对上了。

一个值得注意的点是，作者不仅讨论最终 abstraction，还区分 final abstraction 和 maximum abstraction reached during training。因为训练轨迹可以非单调，模型中途可能更抽象，后期反而回落。这一点对理解 checkpoint 选择、probe 时机、以及中间层监督都很重要。
summary.experiments:
实验分为理论验证和现实模型现象两部分。

理论验证部分，作者在最小合成数据和深线性/非线性网络上检查解析式是否准确预测 abstraction trajectory。文中图 1C 已经给出一个重要现象：真实深网络在 3dshapes 上的 abstraction 轨迹是非单调的，而且平台值明显低于 1，这正是旧理论解释不了的。图 1D 进一步显示 abstraction 与 probe 的跨上下文泛化误差紧密相关，例如只在 red 样本上训练 shape classifier，再测试到 blue 上，其误差趋势能被作者的命题近似预测。这说明 abstraction 不是纯几何指标，而和线性 probe 的 OOD 泛化直接相关。

更贴近大模型的部分在第 5 节。作者对 DINOv3 和 Gemma 4 做非线性消融，结论是 ablate nonlinearity 后，abstraction 提升，线性 probe 泛化也改善。给定正文片段没有完整表格数字，无法可靠抄出具体提升幅度，但从作者的叙述看，这不是单一层的偶然现象，而是跨层可见的趋势。另一个实验方向是神经科学数据：论文展示 macaque ventral stream 层级越往后 abstraction 越强，用来说明理论不只适用于人工网络。

如果从 LLM 研究者角度看，最值得留意的实验不是谁赢了多少点，而是三条经验规律是否成立：1）abstraction 与 probe 跨分布泛化相关；2）非线性，尤其 ReLU，会压低 abstraction；3）训练轨迹可能先升后降，因此只看最终 checkpoint 会漏掉关键信息。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合带着问题读。泛读可先看第 1 节和图 1，抓住作者到底在解释什么现象。然后直接看第 3 节的主定理和图，理解在线性网络里 abstraction trajectory 是如何被精确求出来的。第 4 节值得看，因为它回答了一个更现实的问题：为什么线性理论到了 ReLU 网络里会失真。最后看第 5 节里 DINOv3 和 Gemma 4 的非线性消融，这部分决定它是否只是一篇漂亮理论。

预计阅读时间 35 到 50 分钟。若时间有限，优先顺序是：图 1 → 2FS 设定与 abstraction 定义 → 线性动力学主结果 → 非线性削弱 abstraction 的命题 → Gemma 4 实验。

值得深挖的点有两个。第一，作者把 interaction mode 当作降低 abstraction 的关键“噪声方向”，这和预训练里常见的 entangled features 很接近，可以思考它是否能映射到真实 LLM 中的 token co-occurrence 或 style/topic 混杂方向。第二，论文区分 preactivation 与 feature 的 abstraction，这对解释为什么某些层做 probe 很好、但经过激活后 steering 变差，提供了一个可检验框架。
summary.authors_note: University College London 相关团队，来自 Gatsby Computational Neuroscience Unit 与 Sainsbury Wellcome Centre。给定内容显示为神经科学与机器学习交叉背景作者；具体姓名在片段中未完整展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more fundamental question than whether linear concept directions exist after training: how do they emerge during training, why do they sometimes align only partially, and why is the trajectory often non-monotonic? The authors call this process abstraction, defined as the alignment of concept vectors across contexts. This addresses a real gap in the linear representation hypothesis literature. Static end-state arguments are not enough if one wants to understand when linear probes work, why steering directions are cleaner in some layers than others, or why real networks often plateau far below perfect abstraction.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is conceptual rather than recipe-level. The paper turns abstraction from an endpoint property into a dynamical variable with analytic structure. That matters for understanding representation formation, probe generalization, and layerwise disentanglement in large models. A second contribution is that it ties abstraction to concrete factors: dataset geometry, depth, and nonlinearity. Instead of saying that deeper models or larger models become more abstract, it shows how spectral structure and training dynamics determine which modes dominate and when. Third, the theory is connected back to modern models: the paper reports that ablating nonlinearities improves abstraction and probe generalization in DINOv3 and Gemma 4. That does not immediately yield a better pretraining recipe, but it is useful for mechanistic analysis, representation engineering, and thinking about where linear readouts should or should not be trusted.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper builds its theory in three stages.

First, it solves a minimal linear setting exactly. The setup uses two binary concepts, such as shape and color, giving four classes. The dataset kernel is assumed to have a structured block form called 2FS, which compresses the geometry into a small number of entry types and corresponding modes. In this basis, the representation can be decomposed into interpretable components: concept-aligned modes and an orthogonal interaction mode that reduces parallelism between concept vectors. This interaction mode acts as a noise direction for abstraction. With this decomposition, abstraction, measured as cosine similarity between counterfactual concept vectors, becomes an explicit function of mode amplitudes. The authors then derive exact gradient-descent trajectories for these amplitudes, yielding a closed-form training-time trajectory of abstraction rather than only a convergence statement.

Second, the theory is extended to arbitrary depth in deep linear networks. The key result is not that depth always helps abstraction. Instead, depth changes the relative learning dynamics of different spectral modes. Final abstraction and the maximum abstraction reached during training both depend on how depth reweights the competition between concept modes and interaction modes. This is a more nuanced statement than the common intuition that deeper representations are simply more abstract.

Third, the paper moves to infinite-width nonlinear networks. In this regime, it proves that nonlinearities weaken abstraction in features relative to preactivations. For ReLU in particular, the dynamics become more input-driven and less target-driven, which makes it easier for interaction modes to persist and therefore lowers abstraction. The paper also provides a theoretical explanation for prior empirical observations that tanh-like nonlinearities often produce more abstract representations than ReLU.

An especially useful distinction is between final abstraction and the maximum abstraction attained during training. Because the trajectory can be non-monotonic, the most abstract checkpoint may occur before convergence.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section serves two purposes: validating the theory in controlled settings and checking whether the same qualitative laws appear in modern models.

In controlled experiments, the paper shows that abstraction trajectories in realistic deep networks can be non-monotonic and can plateau well below 1, matching the motivation in Figure 1C using a ConvNet on 3dshapes. Figure 1D is particularly important: abstraction tracks cross-context probe generalization. For example, a shape classifier trained only on red samples and tested on blue samples has an error curve that follows the abstraction measure and is well approximated by the theory. This makes abstraction more than a geometric curiosity; it is tied to out-of-distribution linear readout performance.

The more relevant modern-model evidence appears in Section 5. The authors report that ablating nonlinearities improves abstraction and linear-probe generalization in DINOv3 and Gemma 4. The supplied text does not include the full numerical tables, so it would be unsafe to invent exact gains, but the claim is presented as a consistent trend rather than a one-off layer effect. The paper also analyzes macaque ventral-stream data and finds increasing abstraction along the hierarchy, showing that the framework is intended to bridge machine learning and neuroscience.

For an LLM researcher, the most useful empirical takeaways are three qualitative ones: abstraction correlates with cross-distribution probe generalization; ReLU tends to suppress abstraction relative to more linear or smoother alternatives; and the trajectory can rise and then fall, so the final checkpoint may not be the most abstract one.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this one with a concrete question in mind. Start with Figure 1 and the introduction to understand the phenomenon being explained. Then go to the main linear-theory section and focus on how the 2FS kernel structure and mode decomposition make the abstraction trajectory analytically tractable. After that, read the nonlinear section, because it answers the practical question of why linear-network predictions break in ReLU models. Finally, check the DINOv3 and Gemma 4 experiments in Section 5 to see whether the theory survives contact with modern representations.

A reasonable skim takes 35 to 50 minutes. If time is short, the best path is: Figure 1, the abstraction definition and 2FS setup, the main linear dynamics results, the proposition that nonlinearity weakens abstraction, and then the Gemma 4 evidence.

Two details are worth deeper thought. One is the interaction mode as the main abstraction-reducing direction; this resembles entangled feature directions in pretrained language models and may connect to token co-occurrence or style/topic confounds. The other is the distinction between preactivation and feature abstraction, which offers a concrete lens for why some layers support clean probing while post-activation representations are harder to steer linearly.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from University College London, specifically the Gatsby Computational Neuroscience Unit and the Sainsbury Wellcome Centre. The visible metadata indicates a neuroscience/ML crossover team, but the full author list is not fully shown in the provided excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 不是直接做 LLM，但它把“线性概念为何出现”从事后描述推进到训练动力学；读定理和结论段，能校正你对 probe/steering 可解释性的直觉。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but it upgrades linear-representation talk from post-hoc geometry to training dynamics; read the main results if you use probes or steering and want cleaner priors.

paper.title: Score Accuracy Along the Forward Diffusion Does Not Certify Numerical Stability in Diffusion Sampling
paper.abstract: Score matching controls average error under the forward marginals, but a discretized reverse-time sampler evaluates the learned score along its own trajectory. We show that small forward-marginal error does not guarantee numerical stability. We construct a single smooth score field with arbitrarily small forward-marginal $L^2$ error. The learned reverse-time process is nonexplosive, has moments of every order, and can be arbitrarily close to the exact reverse-time process in path-space total var

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论 score-based diffusion 采样中的一个稳定性盲区：训练时常用的 forward marginal 加权 score error 很小，并不能保证反向采样器的数值稳定。核心点在于，训练误差是在前向扩散分布的典型区域上度量的，而离散化的反向 Euler–Maruyama 采样轨迹可能进入训练分布几乎不覆盖的区域。
summary.importance: 对 diffusion LM 和统一多模态预训练有间接但清晰的启发。它提醒我们，单一的分布加权 score loss 只能约束“数据流形附近”的平均误差，不能自动约束采样器在 off-trajectory 区域的行为。对于离散 token diffusion、masked diffusion LM、图像/文本联合 diffusion 预训练，这意味着训练 loss 很低不等于采样动力学稳定，尤其在长链采样、低温采样、classifier-free guidance 或复杂调度下更明显。贡献主要是理论反例和一个简单稳定化解释，不是新的模型 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造了一个平滑 score 场，在远离前向边缘分布高概率区域的位置加入 inward superlinear perturbation。由于该区域在 forward marginal 下概率极低，L2 score error 可以做得任意小；同时连续时间 learned reverse process 仍然 nonexplosive，具有任意阶矩，并且可在 path-space total variation 上接近精确反向过程。问题出现在显式 Euler–Maruyama 离散化：少量数值轨迹会进入远端扰动区，之后显式更新触发超线性放大。概率很小，但放大幅度足以让任意正阶矩发散。因此 endpoint 可以弱收敛，甚至概率收敛，但所有 Wasserstein-Wp 距离都发散。论文还指出，两个 score 场可以有相同且任意小的 on-path error，但一个离散链有一致矩界，另一个失去所有正阶矩；该现象也可扩展到多维、probability-flow ODE，以及固定有限 GELU 网络架构。正向结果是：若数据支持集位于已知有界闭凸集 C，将 learned denoiser 投影到 C 后再形成 score。投影不会增加逐点 denoiser 或 score error，同时让 Euler 更新的确定性部分拉回有界集合，从而得到 grid-uniform moment bounds。对图像 diffusion 来说，这对应于预测 x0 后做 clipping，论文给出了稳定性层面的解释。
summary.experiments: 这是一篇理论论文，核心结果是构造性反例和定理，而不是经验实验。关键结论包括：可以令 forward-marginal L2 score error 任意小；learned continuous-time reverse process 与 exact reverse process 的 path-space TV 距离任意小；learned process nonexplosive 且拥有任意阶矩；但其 Euler–Maruyama endpoint 虽然在概率意义下收敛，任意 p ≥ 1 的正阶矩均发散，因此 Wp 全部发散。论文还给出对固定有限 GELU 架构内 denoiser 的对应构造，以及 bounded convex support 下 denoiser projection 带来的矩稳定性保证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对反例机制的解释、Setup 中 VE diffusion 与 denoiser parameterization 的定义，以及关于 blind spot 的构造思路。若关心 diffusion 采样理论，需要细读主定理证明中“远端低质量区域 + 超线性显式更新放大”的概率与矩权衡。最后的 projection/clipping 正向结果值得单独看，因为它把图像 diffusion 中常见的 x0 clipping 和数值稳定性连接起来。对 LLM 预训练研究员而言，不必深挖所有测度论细节，但应吸收一个结论：loss 的分布加权方式决定了它能证什么，也决定了它证不了什么。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper identifies a stability gap in score-based diffusion sampling: small score error under the forward marginals does not certify numerical stability of the discretized reverse-time sampler. The learned score is evaluated during training on typical forward-noising states, while an Euler–Maruyama sampler follows its own trajectory and can visit regions that the training loss barely weights.
summary_en.importance: The result is most useful as a warning for diffusion language models and unified multimodal pretraining with diffusion-style objectives. A low distribution-weighted score loss controls average accuracy near the forward process, but it does not control off-trajectory behavior of the sampler. This matters for long sampling chains, aggressive schedules, guidance, and hybrid AR-diffusion systems where numerical trajectories can drift away from the training distribution. The contribution is mainly a theoretical counterexample plus a simple stabilization principle, not a new training recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The construction places a smooth inward superlinear perturbation in a remote region with negligible mass under the forward marginals. This keeps the on-path L2 score error arbitrarily small. It also keeps the learned continuous-time reverse process nonexplosive, with moments of all orders, and arbitrarily close to the exact reverse process in path-space total variation. The failure appears after explicit Euler–Maruyama discretization. Rare numerical trajectories can enter the remote perturbed region, and the explicit updates then repeatedly amplify their magnitude. The probability of such events is tiny, but the amplification dominates the probability cost, so all positive moments of the endpoint diverge. Weak convergence, and even convergence in probability, can coexist with divergence in every Wasserstein-Wp distance. The paper also shows that the same issue can occur in arbitrary dimension, for probability-flow ODEs, and even within a fixed finite GELU architecture. A positive result is obtained for bounded data: if the data support is contained in a known closed convex set, projecting the learned denoiser onto that set before forming the score yields grid-uniform moment bounds. For image diffusion, this gives a stability interpretation of clipping the predicted clean sample.
summary_en.experiments: The paper is theoretical rather than empirical. The main results are constructive guarantees: arbitrarily small forward-marginal L2 score error; arbitrarily small path-space total variation distance between the learned and exact continuous-time reverse processes; nonexplosion and finite moments of all orders for the learned continuous-time process; but divergence of every positive endpoint moment for the Euler–Maruyama discretization. Consequently, all Wasserstein-Wp distances with p ≥ 1 diverge, despite weak convergence. The paper also proves a stabilizing moment bound for denoiser projection under bounded convex data support.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining readers. Read the Introduction for the mechanism, the Setup for the VE diffusion and denoiser parameterization, and the main counterexample section for the probability-versus-amplification tradeoff. The projection result is worth reading separately because it connects a common image diffusion heuristic, predicted-x0 clipping, to numerical stability. The main lesson is that a scalar training loss weighted by the forward marginals has limited certification power; it does not automatically constrain sampler behavior in low-density regions.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion LM 采样时应读反例；它改变的是“低 score loss 足以保稳定”的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Diffusion-LM work should read the counterexample; it breaks the default assumption that low score loss is enough for stable sampling.

paper.title: A First-Principles Theory of Slow Thinking and Active Perception
paper.abstract: As part of a series on first-principles modeling of cognitive functions, this paper attempts to provide a mathematical formulation of thinking and perception. It formally derives slow thinking or more generally, active perception, and encompasses the design, training and inference of slow thinking large language models. Our starting point is the lifting and projection of probability distributions on the observable and latent spaces, with the objective of representing complex data distributions b

summary.core_problem: 尝试从数学第一性原理统一刻画 slow thinking 与 active perception，并把这种表述延伸到 slow-thinking LLM 的设计、训练和推理。
summary.importance: 这是理论/机制取向工作，野心很大，想给“慢思考”建立统一形式化框架。对做 reasoning 或 latent reasoning 范式的人有概念启发，但离可操作的预训练 recipe 还有明显距离。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从可观测空间与潜在空间上的概率分布 lifting/projection 出发，提出 active lifting：通过采样潜在序列，并以最大速率降低不确定性为内在驱动，导出一个包含 slow-thinking 模型的设计空间。文中还定义了 static theory 下的表示层级与采样器层级，认为模型可沿这两个层级升级。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出清晰的实证设置、模型规模、数据规模或与主流 reasoning/slow-thinking 方法的定量对比。更像理论框架论文，实验可信度和可复现性需要看正文后再判断。
