如果你做系统或推理优化，最值得看的是第 7 章“From Softmax KDE to Attention”，因为这里才是和 KV cache compression 直接相关的结论。若你更关心理论方法，可以看第 6 章上界部分，尤其是 pseudo-random / low-radius 划分、recenter & rescale、以及如何从离线压缩转成 streaming。下界部分则适合确认哪些工程目标在理论上可能过于乐观。

预计阅读时间 25 到 40 分钟可抓住主结论；若要跟完整证明，时间会明显更长。阅读时建议把前作 Haris et al. 和 Kochetkova et al. 放在旁边，对照看 gap 是如何被缩小的。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the memory complexity of streaming attention: how much of the KV cache can be compressed while still approximating full softmax attention within a target error. The goal is not to propose another heuristic cache policy, but to tighten the theoretical upper and lower bounds for the approximation problem. More concretely, it addresses gaps left by recent theory papers on streaming attention and asks, across different temperature regimes and error levels, what memory is sufficient and what memory is information-theoretically necessary.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model researchers, the value is as a sharper reference point for KV-cache compression. Much of the current work in this area is heuristic and highly dependent on data, layer, head, and implementation choices. Without theory, it is hard to know whether a method is close to optimal or far from it. By recasting attention approximation through softmax kernel density estimation and coreset constructions, this paper gives tighter bounds that clarify the achievable frontier of streaming attention. It does not change pretraining directly, but it matters for long-context modeling, inference-memory budgeting, and for judging whether architecture changes aimed at streamability are worth their cost.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical route has three main pieces. First, the paper reformulates attention approximation in terms of softmax KDE. This is natural because attention weights are normalized exponential kernels between queries and keys. Once written this way, the problem can be attacked using tools from coresets, polynomial approximation, high-dimensional geometry, and communication complexity.

Second, the analysis is split by regime. The table of contents makes clear that the authors treat a high-temperature regime and a low-temperature regime separately. Intuitively, when temperature is high, softmax is smoother and more amenable to low-degree approximation; when temperature is low, the kernel becomes sharper, local geometry matters more, and compression becomes harder. The paper therefore avoids a single coarse statement and instead derives regime-specific upper and lower bounds.

Third, the upper and lower bounds use different toolchains. On the upper-bound side, the paper employs multivariate polynomial methods, Hermite polynomials, KDE coresets, and a merge-and-reduce style conversion from offline compression to streaming compression. In the low-temperature regime, the contents indicate a more delicate pipeline: partition the dataset into pseudo-random and low-radius components, recenter and rescale them, build coresets for each part, then turn the offline compressor into a streaming algorithm. This suggests that the main technical novelty lies in decomposing the geometry of the instance before compressing it.

On the lower-bound side, the paper uses information-theoretic and communication-complexity arguments to show that some memory requirements are inherent rather than artifacts of loose analysis. The final section transfers the softmax-KDE results back to attention, yielding formal bounds for streaming attention itself.

Relative to prior work by Haris et al. and Kochetkova et al., the contribution here is not a new framework but a tighter characterization of the same problem.
summary_en.experiments:
This is a theory paper, so there are no standard model-training experiments or benchmark tables. The main outputs are theorems: upper and lower bounds in different regimes, and the extent to which the gap between them is reduced. From the structure, Theorem 2.1 and Theorem 2.2 appear to correspond to the high-temperature and low-temperature settings, and Section 7 translates the softmax-KDE statements into attention guarantees.

If one reads the theorems as the equivalent of empirical results, the key quantities to inspect are the memory complexity as a function of approximation error epsilon, ambient dimension, and the temperature or radius parameter r, together with whether upper and lower bounds match up to logarithmic or lower-order factors. The provided excerpt contains the table of contents rather than the theorem statements, so it would be unsafe to invent exact formulas. What is clear is that the paper sharpens the theory by treating the two regimes separately and by using a finer geometric decomposition in the upper-bound construction.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Do not start from the proofs. Begin with the introduction and the statement of results to identify exactly which gaps from earlier work are being closed. Then read the technical overview, focusing on why the high-temperature and low-temperature regimes require different arguments.

If your interest is systems or inference optimization, Section 7, “From Softmax KDE to Attention,” is the most relevant part because it contains the translation back to KV-cache compression. If you care more about the theory itself, the upper-bound construction in Section 6 is likely the most informative, especially the partition into pseudo-random and low-radius components, the recenter-and-rescale step, and the offline-to-streaming conversion. The lower bounds are useful for understanding which engineering goals may simply be too optimistic.

A skim should take about 25–40 minutes. A full proof read will take much longer. It is helpful to keep the earlier papers by Haris et al. and Kochetkova et al. nearby and compare exactly where the new bounds become tighter.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 KV-cache 压缩，这篇该读；不是因为它能立刻提速，而是它在收紧可达边界，能帮你判断现有 heuristic 到底是没调好，还是问题本身就难。
recommendation.en: If you work on KV-cache compression, read this—not for immediate speedups, but because tighter bounds tell you whether current heuristics are under-engineered or fundamentally up against the wall.

paper.title: Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence: Explanatory Insufficiency as a Driver of Representation Learning and World Models
paper.abstract: Representation learning is central to modern machine learning, enabling transitions from handcrafted features to learned embeddings, latent spaces, foundation models, world models, and digital twins. Yet most research examines how representations are optimized after a representational framework has been selected, while less attention is given to when a new level of representation becomes necessary. We introduce the Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence (TBER), a framework describing how

summary.core_problem: 现有研究关注表征框架选定后如何优化，但较少关注何时需要新的表征层级的问题。
summary.importance: 理论创新：首次提出表征涌现的自举理论(TBER)，将解释不足识别为表征转变的积极信号。
summary.technical_approach: TBER框架描述当现有表征仍能描述观察但无法解释其组织或变换时，新表征如何产生；解释不足是表征创新的驱动因素。
summary.experiments: 纯理论框架，无实验验证。

summary_en.core_problem: Most research focuses on optimizing representations after a framework is selected, with less attention to when a new level of representation becomes necessary.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical innovation: proposes the Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence (TBER), identifying explanatory insufficiency as a positive signal for representational transition.
summary_en.technical_approach: TBER framework describes how new representations arise when existing ones can still describe observations but no longer make their organization or transformations intelligible; explanatory insufficiency drives representational innovation.
summary_en.experiments: Pure theoretical framework, no experimental validation.

recommendation.zh: 高度抽象的表征学习理论框架，非针对LLM，对LLM机制分析仅有间接启发，读摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Highly abstract theoretical framework on representation learning, not specific to LLMs; indirect intellectual interest for mechanism analysis but no direct practical value. Read abstract only.

paper.title: Learning What to Forget: Improving LLM Unlearning via Learned Token-Level Importance
paper.abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted knowledge from a trained model while preserving its general capabilities. For autoregressive language models, not all tokens in a forget sample are equally relevant to forgetting. Existing approaches either ignore this heterogeneity or rely on auxiliary models, heuristics, or external annotations to estimate each token's relevance for forgetting. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 LLM unlearning 里一个很实际但常被粗糙处理的问题：给定一条需要遗忘的样本，真正承载待删除知识的 token 只占一部分，很多 token 只是通用语言结构。如果对整条 forget sample 一视同仁地施加 forget loss，就会把结构性 token 也一起压低，结果是 retain 能力受损，但目标知识未必删得更干净。作者要解决的核心问题是：能不能不依赖外部标注、辅助模型或启发式规则，而是直接从 forget objective 与 retain objective 的冲突关系中，学出 token 级别的“该忘程度”。
summary.importance: 对预训练和持续训练研究的意义主要在接口层。严格说这不是预训练方法论文，但它触及一个很关键的问题：当模型参数里混合存储了通用语言能力和局部知识时，训练信号应该如何更细粒度地分配。这个问题和 continual pretrain、数据删除、版权/隐私治理、post-train 对 base model 的局部改写都有共通结构。作者把 token 选择从外部启发式改成由 retain–forget 张力内生决定，这一点有方法论价值：它说明“哪些更新该发生”可以由优化目标自己识别，而不一定要另起一个打分器或人工规则。对做数据质量、训练信号设计、局部编辑的人来说，这篇文章的启发不在 unlearning 任务本身，而在于它把 token-level credit assignment 写成了一个联合优化问题。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 ATWU，Alternating Token-Weighted Unlearning。作者先给出一个理论化定义：某个 forget token 如果施加 forget 更新后仍能与 retain 最优性兼容，它就是 forget-specific；反过来，如果对该 token 做 forget 会明显破坏 retain objective，它更可能只是结构性 token，不该被强力遗忘。基于这个定义，作者把 token 权重视为联合优化中的潜变量，而不是预先给定的标签。形式上，目标同时优化模型参数和 forget token 的权重，使得模型在 retain 集上保持接近最优，同时只在真正与 forget 目标一致的 token 上施加更强的遗忘压力。论文声称在一个自然的 separation condition 下，这个联合目标可以恢复 oracle 级别的 forget-specific support，也就是理论上能把“该忘的 token 子集”识别出来。实现上，ATWU 用一个轻量 scorer 来参数化 token 权重。这个 scorer 不是独立大模型，而是 hidden-state 空间中的线性方向，对每个 token 的表示打分，再经过归一化或门控形成权重。训练时采用 alternating updates：一步固定模型、更新 scorer，让权重更好地区分 retain-compatible 与 retain-conflicting 的 forget token；下一步固定 scorer、按加权 forget objective 更新模型。这样做的原因是直接联合训练容易不稳定，token 权重和模型参数会相互追逐，交替优化更容易收敛，也更接近 EM 式的“先估计责任，再更新参数”。从摘要和正文片段看，作者对比了几类基线：sample-level unlearning、不加 token 区分的方法、基于概率启发式的方法、以及依赖辅助模型或外部标注的方法。ATWU 的卖点是只用 retain/forget 目标本身就能学出更合理的 token 重要性。
summary.experiments: 实验在 TOFU 和 RWKU 两个 unlearning benchmark 上进行。全文片段没有给出完整数表，但能确认的结果方向比较清楚。第一，ATWU 在 forget–retain trade-off 上优于 sample-level baseline，也优于概率型 token heuristic 和 auxiliary-model-based token weighting，说明 learned token importance 确实减少了不必要的能力损伤。第二，作者不仅看最终 unlearning 指标，还检查 token score 与 ground-truth forget-specific spans 的对齐情况，结果显示学到的权重更集中在名字、日期、属性短语、稀有标识符等真正承载目标知识的片段，而不是 function words、标点和通用句法 token。第三，论文的理论部分和实验部分是配套的：理论上说 token 权重应由 retain conflict 决定，实验上则通过 span 对齐和 retain 保真度来支持这一点。由于给出的正文被截断，暂时无法可靠复述参数规模、训练步数、具体提升百分比等细节；但从结构上看，这篇文章的关键证据不是单一 benchmark 分数，而是“权重是否真的学到了该忘的局部支持集”。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，重点看问题建模而不是任务背景。先读 Introduction，抓住作者和已有 token-weighted unlearning 方法的分歧：别人把 token 权重当外部信息，作者把它当 retain–forget 联合目标里的隐变量。然后看“Token-Weighted Unlearning as a Joint Optimization Problem”这一节，理解 forget-specific 的定义、separation condition 想表达什么，以及为什么这个定义比“低概率 token 更该忘”更稳。接着看 ATWU 的 scorer 设计和 alternating optimization 流程，判断它是否足够轻量、是否容易迁移到别的局部编辑或 continual setting。最后看实验里关于 token span 对齐的可视化或定量结果，这部分比总分更能说明方法是否真的抓住了知识承载 token。预计 25–35 分钟可以读完主线；如果你关心训练信号分配、局部知识删除、数据治理，这篇值得记下其联合优化视角。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical weakness in LLM unlearning: within a forget sample, only some tokens actually carry the knowledge that should be removed, while many others are generic linguistic scaffolding. If the forget loss is applied uniformly to all tokens, the model is pushed to suppress both the target content and the surrounding structure, which hurts retain performance without necessarily improving forgetting where it matters. The core question is whether token-level forget importance can be learned directly from the interaction between the forget and retain objectives, rather than from heuristics, external annotations, or auxiliary models.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface and to continual adaptation. The broader lesson is about fine-grained credit assignment in parameter updates: when general language competence and localized knowledge are entangled in the same model, how should the training signal decide what to change and what to preserve? That question appears in unlearning, data deletion, copyright/privacy compliance, local model editing, and continual pretraining. The paper’s main methodological contribution is to make token selection endogenous to the optimization problem itself. Instead of importing a separate notion of token importance, it derives importance from retain–forget compatibility. That framing is useful beyond unlearning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is ATWU, Alternating Token-Weighted Unlearning. The paper first formalizes a notion of forget-specificity: a forget token is important to unlearn if applying the forget objective to that token is compatible with staying near retain optimality; if forgetting that token strongly conflicts with the retain objective, it is more likely to be structural rather than target-bearing. This turns token weights into latent variables in a joint optimization over model parameters and token importance. Under a stated separation condition, the authors argue that the objective can recover the oracle support of forget-specific tokens. In practice, ATWU uses a lightweight scorer to assign token weights from hidden states, parameterized as a linear direction in the LM representation space rather than a separate large auxiliary model. Training alternates between updating the scorer and updating the model. The intuition is that direct simultaneous optimization can be unstable because the model and the weights co-adapt too quickly; alternating updates make the procedure closer to an EM-like loop where token responsibility is estimated and then used to drive parameter updates. The method is compared against sample-level unlearning, probability-based token heuristics, and auxiliary-model-based weighting. Its main claim is that the retain objective is not just a regularizer but also an informative signal for identifying which forget tokens should actually receive strong forgetting pressure.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on TOFU and RWKU. The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, but the qualitative findings are clear. First, ATWU improves the forget–retain trade-off over sample-level baselines, heuristic token weighting, and auxiliary-model-based methods, indicating that learned token importance reduces unnecessary collateral damage. Second, the paper evaluates not only end-task unlearning metrics but also alignment between learned token scores and ground-truth forget-specific spans. The learned weights concentrate more on names, dates, attribute-bearing phrases, and rare identifiers, rather than on function words or punctuation. Third, the empirical evidence is aligned with the theory: the paper argues that retain conflict should define forget-specificity, and then shows that the learned scores track the content-bearing spans while preserving retain behavior better. Because the full content is truncated, I cannot reliably reproduce model sizes, exact gains, or training budgets from the available text. The main experimental value lies in showing that the method identifies a more plausible support set for forgetting, not just that it shifts a benchmark score.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is best read for its formulation rather than for the task background. Start with the Introduction and note the key departure from prior token-weighted unlearning work: previous methods treat token importance as external information, while this paper treats it as a latent variable induced by the retain–forget objective pair. Then read the joint-optimization section carefully, especially the definition of forget-specificity and the role of the separation condition. That part tells you what the method is trying to estimate and why this criterion is more principled than simple probability heuristics. After that, look at the ATWU scorer design and the alternating optimization procedure. The practical question to ask is whether this mechanism is lightweight enough to transfer to other local-editing or continual-learning settings. Finally, inspect the token-span alignment results or visualizations, because they provide stronger evidence than aggregate benchmark metrics alone. A 25–35 minute skim should be enough to capture the main idea.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但把 unlearning 写成 retain/forget 冲突分解这点很干净；先看理论定义和消融，若大模型实验不扎实就当目标设计信号。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but the retain-vs-forget conflict view is unusually clean; read the objective and ablations first, and treat it as an objective-design signal if the large-model setup is thin.

institutions: Theory of Machine Learning Lab, EPFL

paper.title: High-Dimensional Theory of LoRA Fine-Tuning in a Solvable Attention Model
paper.abstract: We develop a high-dimensional statistical theory of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) in attention models, capturing the interplay between pre-training and fine-tuning. We introduce a solvable framework in which a single-head attention layer is first pre-trained on a data-abundant task and subsequently adapted via a rank-one LoRA update on limited data. In the high-dimensional limit, both stages admit a sharp asymptotic characterization in terms of a finite set of order parameters, yielding explicit pr

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LoRA 微调在预训练之后为什么有效，以及预训练质量、预训练样本量、微调样本量如何共同决定 LoRA 的泛化。它不分析真实 Transformer 的完整复杂性，而是构造一个可解的高维 attention 模型，把 full-rank 预训练和 rank-one LoRA 微调放在同一个统计框架里。
summary.importance: 对大模型预训练的价值在于提供一个可计算的 pretrain-to-finetune 理论模型。它不是工程 recipe，也不能直接推出真实 LLM 的 LoRA 最优配置；但它把“预训练给微调留下了什么”压缩为 effective noise 这类可分析量，并给出测试误差、表示对齐、重构 overlap 的关系。这个角度对理解继续预训练、PEFT、数据质量和下游适配之间的取舍有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用一个单头 tied-attention layer。输入是长度为 T、维度为 D 的 token 序列。预训练阶段学习一个大秩矩阵 W，目标是 extensive-rank attention-indexed model；微调阶段冻结 W，只学习一个 rank-one LoRA 分量 w。模型包含 tied keys/queries、identity values，并考虑 row-wise softmax 或 rescaled identity activation。训练目标是带 L2 正则的经验风险，预训练样本数 N 较大，微调样本数 N' 较小。在 D、N、N'、P 按比例增长的高维极限下，作者把两个阶段的学习过程归约为有限个 scalar order parameters，用这些量预测预训练测试误差、LoRA 微调测试误差以及与真实目标的 overlap。相对 NTK 或 lazy-training 分析，这里关注 feature-learning regime；相对一般化界，它给的是 sharp asymptotic learning curve。
summary.experiments: 这是一篇理论论文，核心结果是高维极限下的显式表征和学习曲线预测，而不是大规模 LLM 实验。文中给出的主要现象包括：预训练对 LoRA 的影响可以通过一个 effective-noise 机制总结；预训练目标和正则强度会改变微调阶段可见的噪声水平；在某些区域，微调测试误差与重构 overlap 会出现不一致，即模型可以通过记忆预训练数据获得较好预测误差，但表示恢复质量并不好。根据提供内容，未看到真实语言模型或实际 LoRA adapter 的实验数字，因此不应把结论外推为工程定律。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 分钟。重点看 Section 2 的 two-stage model，确认 W、w、样本规模、attention activation 和正则项的设定。然后看 main theorem 或 order-parameter 方程，关注测试误差和 overlap 如何由少数标量决定。effective-noise 相关部分最值得细看，因为它直接连接预训练质量和微调表现。最后看 test error 与 reconstruction overlap mismatch 的例子。推导细节可以跳读，除非需要复现高维理论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how LoRA fine-tuning depends on the pre-training stage in a setting where the interaction can be solved analytically. Instead of modeling a full Transformer, it builds a high-dimensional attention model in which a large-rank component is pre-trained on abundant data and a rank-one LoRA component is later fitted on limited downstream data.
summary_en.importance: Its value is conceptual rather than immediately prescriptive. The paper provides a tractable pretrain-to-finetune theory for attention, with explicit predictions for test error and representation alignment. The most useful idea is that the effect of pre-training on LoRA can be summarized through an effective-noise mechanism. This is relevant for thinking about PEFT, continual pre-training, and downstream adaptation, but the conclusions should not be treated as direct hyperparameter rules for production LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model is a single-head tied-attention layer over sequences of length T and token dimension D. The pre-training stage learns a high-rank matrix W on an extensive-rank attention-indexed target, with L2 regularization. The fine-tuning stage freezes W and learns only a rank-one LoRA vector w from a smaller dataset. Keys and queries are tied, values are identity, and the activation is either row-wise softmax or a rescaled identity map. In the high-dimensional limit, with D, N, N', and the rank P scaling together, both stages are characterized by a finite set of scalar order parameters. These parameters yield sharp predictions for pre-training error, fine-tuning error, and overlaps with the ground-truth structure. Compared with NTK-style LoRA analyses, the emphasis is on feature learning after pre-training rather than lazy dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The main results are theoretical learning-curve characterizations, not empirical LLM evaluations. The paper identifies an effective-noise quantity that mediates the impact of pre-training quality on LoRA performance and uses it to derive prescriptions for pre-training and idealized fine-tuning data selection. It also describes regimes where low fine-tuning test error does not imply good reconstruction overlap, due to memorization effects from the pre-training data. Based on the provided content, there are no real-model LoRA numbers or large-scale language-model experiments to report.
summary_en.reading_guide: Plan for a 30-minute skim. Read the two-stage model carefully first: the definitions of W, w, the sample sizes, the attention activation, and the regularized objectives determine what the theory does and does not cover. Then inspect the main asymptotic characterization and the order-parameter equations. The effective-noise section is the most useful part for LLM researchers, because it connects pre-training quality to adaptation performance. The detailed derivations can be skipped unless the goal is to reproduce or extend the high-dimensional analysis.

recommendation.zh: 不是直接给 recipe 的论文，但它把 pretrain→LoRA 的接口讲成了可分析对象；先看 effective noise 和 error/alignment 失配那部分，可能会改你对“好表示=好微调”的直觉。
recommendation.en: Not a recipe paper, but it turns the pretrain-to-LoRA interface into something analyzable; focus on the effective-noise view and the error/alignment mismatch.

paper.title: A Quantitative Approximation Framework for Flow Distillation in Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: We develop a quantitative approximation framework for diffusion distillation, viewing few-step sampling as error propagation under compositions of learned flow maps. Focusing on trajectory distillation for the probability-flow ODE, we show that local approximation errors can be strongly amplified in low-noise multimodal regimes, where the underlying dynamics become stiff. In an analytically tractable Gaussian-mixture Ornstein--Uhlenbeck setting, we separate two core difficulties: approximating t

summary.core_problem: 量化分析 diffusion distillation 中少步采样为什么会失真，尤其是概率流 ODE 在低噪声、多模态区域的误差放大问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是理论分析。它把少步生成看成一串学习到的 flow map 组合，指出蒸馏误差不只来自 score 近似，还来自 ODE 动力系统本身的 Jacobian 放大；这对理解 diffusion/flow 模型的少步蒸馏稳定性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在 Gaussian-mixture Ornstein--Uhlenbeck 设置下拆分两个难点：一是时间依赖 score field 的函数逼近，二是概率流 ODE 的动力学放大。方法上给出 ReLU-ReQU 网络对 Gaussian mixture score 的构造性 L^p(p_t) 逼近保证，并用时间积分 Jacobian bound 描述误差传播和 stiffness。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要描述理论结果，没有给出大规模图像、视频或语言模型实验。核心结果是深度和宽度随目标精度呈 polylog 级别缩放，并显式依赖 mixture geometry；稳定性部分给出空间 Lipschitz bound L(t) 及其对误差放大的约束。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自复旦大学及上海市现代应用数学重点实验室。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why few-step diffusion distillation can fail by quantifying error propagation in probability-flow ODE sampling, especially in low-noise multimodal regimes.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly theoretical. It frames distilled few-step sampling as a composition of learned flow maps and separates score approximation error from dynamical amplification caused by stiff ODE behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis uses a Gaussian-mixture Ornstein--Uhlenbeck setting. It proves constructive L^p(p_t) approximation guarantees for Gaussian-mixture scores using ReLU-ReQU networks, and analyzes stability through time-integrated Jacobian or Lipschitz bounds of the probability-flow ODE.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports theoretical approximation and stability bounds rather than large-scale empirical results. Network depth and width scale polylogarithmically with target accuracy and explicitly with mixture geometry.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Fudan University and the Shanghai Key Laboratory of Contemporary Applied Mathematics.

recommendation.zh: 不直接服务 LLM 预训练；只看误差放大分析即可，低噪声 stiff regime 对 diffusion 蒸馏有借鉴。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM pretraining paper; skim the error-amplification argument if you care about few-step diffusion distillation stability.

paper.title: Agentic Transformers Provably Learn to Search via Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Tree search is a central abstraction behind many language-agent reasoning and decision-making tasks: agents must explore actions, remember failures, and backtrack toward promising alternatives. Yet, we lack a theoretical understanding of how transformer-based policies acquire such search capabilities from the training dynamics of reinforcement learning (RL). We study this question in a stochastic $k$-ary tree environment, where an agentic transformer observes only its trajectory history through

summary.core_problem: 语言模型Agent在推理和决策任务中广泛依赖树状搜索原语（探索、回溯、记忆失败路径），但缺乏理论理解：基于Transformer的策略如何通过强化学习（RL）的训练动态，仅从交互轨迹历史和终端奖励信号中习得结构化搜索能力。
summary.importance: 该工作首次在理论层面建立了"Transformer架构 + RL训练 → 涌现搜索能力"的可证结果，为理解Agentic行为的涌现机制提供了形式化框架。虽然是简化环境中的理论研究，但对RL预训练（如R1-Zero范式）、Agent能力习得的课程设计有方法论参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在随机k叉树环境中（k≥2，深度L≥2），Agent仅能通过交互观测轨迹历史，到达隐藏叶子目标时获得终端奖励。作者首先构造了一个双头Transformer实现随机深度优先搜索（DFS）：一个注意力头跟踪之前的动作以避免重复，另一个头检测失败结局并触发回溯。随后证明在深度渐进式课程训练（depth-wise curriculum）下，策略梯度训练可以让Transformer学习到该搜索策略，并给出了收敛速率和泛化误差的理论界。分析进一步拓展到目标分布不平衡的情况。
summary.experiments: 数值实验验证了理论预测：(1) 构造的Transformer在k叉树环境中正确执行随机DFS；(2) 课程训练下策略梯度收敛到目标策略；(3) 学习到的策略泛化到未见过的树深度和结构。实验为理论验证性质的小规模数值模拟，非大规模实际Agent benchmark。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计30-40分钟（理论论文，证明部分技术性强）。对预训练研究员建议重点看Section 2（Transformer构造与随机DFS的实现机制，理解注意力如何实现搜索原语）和Section 3（训练动态与课程训练分析，了解RL训练下搜索能力如何涌现）。附录A-C的详细证明可跳过。
summary.authors_note: Tong Yang (CMU ECE), Yu Huang (UPenn Wharton Statistics & Data Science), Yingbin Liang (Ohio State ECE), Yuejie Chi (Yale Statistics & Data Science)

summary_en.core_problem: Language model agents rely on tree-search primitives (exploration, backtracking, memory of failure paths) for reasoning and decision-making, but a theoretical gap remains: how do transformer-based policies acquire structured search capabilities from RL training dynamics, given only trajectory history and terminal reward signals?
summary_en.importance: This is the first theoretical work establishing provable results connecting transformer architecture, RL training dynamics, and the emergence of structured search capabilities. It provides a formal framework for understanding agentic behavior emergence, with methodological implications for RL-pretraining (e.g., the R1-Zero paradigm) and curriculum design for agent capability acquisition, though it is a theoretical study in a simplified environment.
summary_en.technical_approach: In a stochastic k-ary tree environment (k ≥ 2, depth L ≥ 2), an agent observes only its trajectory history through interaction and receives a terminal reward upon reaching a hidden leaf goal. The authors first construct a two-head transformer implementing randomized DFS: one attention head tracks previous actions to avoid repeats, while a second head detects failure outcomes and triggers backtracking. They then prove that under depth-wise curriculum training, policy gradient can learn such a search strategy, providing theoretical bounds on convergence rate and generalization error. The analysis extends to settings with imbalanced goal distributions.
summary_en.experiments: Numerical experiments validate the theoretical predictions: (1) the constructed transformer correctly implements randomized DFS on k-ary trees; (2) policy gradient converges to the target policy under curriculum training; (3) the learned policy generalizes to unseen tree depths and structures. Experiments are small-scale theoretical simulations, not large-scale agent benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim read, estimated 30–40 minutes (theoretical paper with dense proofs). For pretraining researchers, focus on Section 2 (transformer construction for DFS — how attention implements search primitives) and Section 3 (training dynamics and curriculum analysis — how RL yields emergent search). The detailed proofs in Appendices A–C can be skipped.
summary_en.authors_note: Tong Yang (CMU ECE), Yu Huang (UPenn Wharton Statistics & Data Science), Yingbin Liang (Ohio State ECE), Yuejie Chi (Yale Statistics & Data Science)

recommendation.zh: 把“RL让Transformer学会搜索”讲成可证明的分阶段机制，值得读其构造与curriculum假设；但离真实LLM环境仍远。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the constructive DFS transformer and staged policy-gradient emergence under curriculum, but the assumptions are far from real LLM agent settings.

paper.title: Revisiting Padded Transformer Expressivity: Which Architectural Choices Matter and Which Don't
paper.abstract: Recent work describes what transformers can and cannot compute through connections to boolean circuits, but existing results lack exact characterizations and are sensitive to modeling choices. Padded transformers -- to whose input filler symbols such as ``...'' are appended -- emerge as a useful gadget for establishing equivalences to circuit classes by providing polynomial space for adaptive parallel computation. However, only a limited set of padded transformer idealizations has been studied,

summary.core_problem: Transformer表达性理论研究结果高度依赖具体建模假设（如soft vs hard注意力、数值精度），导致结论零散且难以调和。本文系统研究padded transformer（在输入后附加多项式数量填充符号的Transformer）在不同架构选择下的表达性鲁棒性，并将其与布尔电路类建立精确对应关系。
summary.importance: 对预训练架构研究提供理论参考：填充机制（如pause token、扩散语言模型中的自适应推理步数）带来的表达性提升在不同注意力类型和宽度下是稳健的，但数值精度和深度才是最终瓶颈。这提示实践中增加填充/推理步长可能比调整注意力类型或宽度更有效。
summary.technical_approach: 系统分析L-一致多项式padded transformer族（L-uniform指参数可由logspace图灵机构造）的表达性，考察三个维度：(1)注意力类型——softmax(SMAT) vs 平均硬注意力(AHAT)；(2)数值精度、宽度、深度的缩放；(3)参数一致性条件。通过将AHAT模拟为SMAT、将SMAT结果迁移至AHAT、扩展已有结论，统一了先前分散的刻画。发现一旦达到对数精度，注意力类型、宽度甚至进一步提高精度都不改变表达性；而对数精度padded transformer严格强于常数精度版本，且表达性随深度增长。
summary.experiments: 纯理论分析，无实证实验。通过构造性证明建立了多种padded transformer变体与AC^d/TC^d等自然电路类之间的等价关系。核心技术贡献是将London & Kanade(2025)对SMAT的刻画与Merrill & Sabharwal(2025)对AHAT的刻画统一起来，证明在对数精度下二者等价。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看Fig.1的全景图快速把握结果结构（不同假设下的表达性等价类）。核心阅读章节是：第3章AHAT与SMAT的互模拟构造，第4章精度对表达性的影响，第5章深度的作用。阅读难度较高（理论CS/TCS风格），需具备计算复杂度理论基础。建议跳过冗长的形式化证明，聚焦main theorem的陈述和讨论（约30-45分钟）。
summary.authors_note: 无法从提供内容中确认具体作者与机构

summary_en.core_problem: Transformer expressivity results are highly sensitive to modeling choices (soft vs hard attention, numeric precision), yielding fragmented and hard-to-reconcile conclusions. This paper systematically studies the robustness of padded transformers (transformers with polynomially many filler symbols appended to input) across architectural choices and establishes exact correspondences to boolean circuit classes.
summary_en.importance: Provides theoretical grounding for architecture design in pretraining: the expressivity gain from padding (related to pause tokens, adaptive inference steps in diffusion LMs) is robust across attention types and widths, but numeric precision and depth are the ultimate bottlenecks. This suggests that adding padding/inference steps may be more effective than tuning attention type or width.
summary_en.technical_approach: Systematically analyzes the expressivity of L-uniform polynomial padded transformer families (L-uniform: parameters constructible by a logspace Turing machine) across three axes: (1) attention type — softmax (SMAT) vs average hard attention (AHAT); (2) scaling of numeric precision, width, and depth; (3) uniformity conditions. Unifies prior disparate characterizations by constructing mutual simulations between AHAT and SMAT, translating SMAT results to AHAT, and extending existing work. Key finding: once logarithmic precision is achieved, attention type, width, and further precision increases do not alter expressivity; log-precision padded transformers are strictly more expressive than constant-precision ones, and expressivity grows with depth.
summary_en.experiments: Pure theoretical analysis — no empirical experiments. Results are constructive proofs establishing equivalences between various padded transformer variants and natural circuit classes (AC^d, TC^d). Unifies London & Kanade (2025) on SMAT with Merrill & Sabharwal (2025) on AHAT, proving equivalence under log-precision.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Fig.1 for a panoramic view of the landscape (equivalence classes under different assumptions). Key chapters: §3 AHAT-SMAT mutual simulation, §4 impact of numeric precision, §5 role of depth. High reading difficulty (theoretical CS/TCS style), requires background in computational complexity theory. Skip lengthy formal proofs and focus on main theorem statements and discussion (approx 30-45 min).

recommendation.zh: 读定理表和假设即可；它把“架构细节影响表达力”的 prior 收窄到精度和深度两项。
recommendation.en: Read the theorem table and assumptions; it narrows the expressivity prior from many architectural knobs to mainly precision and depth.

paper.title: Pairwise Reference Alignment as a Model-Level Ordinal Observable
paper.abstract: Pairwise preference data is widely used in language-model evaluation and alignment, often for model ranking, reward modeling, or preference optimization. This note formulates a more basic measurement question: given a reference distribution of pairwise preferences, what model-level quantity is estimated when we test whether a model ranks preferred responses above rejected responses?   We define pairwise reference alignment as an ordinal observable induced by a model scoring function. Given a ref

summary.core_problem: 这篇短文想回答一个更基础的问题：在给定成对偏好分布时，用“模型是否把 preferred response 排在 rejected response 之前”这个检验，究竟在估计什么模型层面的量。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是测量定义而不是新训练方法。它把常见的 pairwise preference accuracy 形式化为一个 model-level ordinal observable，并给出中心化统计量、margin 扩展以及有限样本估计与集中界。对做对齐、reward modeling、judge 设计的人有概念澄清价值，但对预训练本身的直接推动有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者定义了基于参考分布 P_pair(x, y+, y-) 和模型标量打分函数 S_M(x, y) 的 pairwise reference alignment：即模型诱导排序与参考偏好排序一致的概率。进一步给出一个类似 order parameter 的中心化统计量，并讨论 margin-based 版本。方法上更像统计测量框架，核心是把常用 pairwise ranking 指标解释为可估计的序量观测量，而不是提出新的优化目标或新模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要里没有看到新的大规模模型实验，也明确说明没有引入新的训练算法、数据集或基准。实验部分大概率以定义、估计器和理论性质为主，价值在于统一解释 pairwise preference evaluation，而不是展示性能提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The note asks a basic measurement question: given a reference distribution of pairwise preferences, what model-level quantity is actually being estimated when we test whether a model ranks preferred responses above rejected ones?
summary_en.importance: This is a measurement clarification rather than a new training method. It formalizes pairwise preference accuracy as a model-level ordinal observable, with a centered statistic, a margin-based extension, and finite-sample concentration results. Useful for alignment and reward-model evaluation hygiene, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines pairwise reference alignment from a reference pair distribution P_pair(x, y+, y-) and a scalar model score S_M(x, y), as the probability that the model-induced ordering matches the reference ordering. It then introduces a centered order-parameter-like statistic and discusses a margin-aware variant. The contribution is a statistical framing of an existing practice, not a new optimization or modeling recipe.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not indicate new large-scale model experiments and explicitly says no new training algorithm, dataset, or benchmark is introduced. The empirical side appears limited to estimators and theoretical properties rather than capability gains.

recommendation.zh: 偏概念澄清，不会改变训练做法；如果你在做 RM/judge 评测口径统一，可只看定义和 concentration bound，其余略过。
recommendation.en: Mostly a measurement note, not a training paper; read the definition and concentration result if you care about RM/judge metric hygiene, otherwise skip.

paper.title: Theoretical Foundations and Effective Algorithms for Policy-Aware Simulator Learning
paper.abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) agents typically learn world models by minimizing predictive loss. However, powerful RL optimizers inevitably exploit minor model inaccuracies, leading to simulator exploitation and a reality gap where policies succeed in simulation but fail in the real world. We propose that the objective for learning simulators should be strategic robustness rather than predictive accuracy, and formulate this as a zero-sum minimax game between a model player and an adv

summary.core_problem: 解决模型式强化学习里“预测误差很小但策略仍会利用模拟器漏洞”的问题，即如何让 learned simulator 对策略优化具有战略鲁棒性而不只是拟合观测。
summary.importance: 贡献偏理论与算法：把 simulator learning 从预测损失最小化改写成模型与对抗策略之间的零和博弈，并给出 regret、critic 近似和 Error-MDP 对偶分析。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对 world model、agent training、reward hacking 与 simulator exploitation 的理解有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心做法是把模拟器学习目标定义为最坏策略下的价值差最小化，而非一步预测误差最小化。作者给出三层结果：在线学习视角下的可学习性与次线性遗憾界；用局部 critic loss 上界全局 policy-value gap 的可 tractable 简化；以及 Error-MDP duality，把寻找最坏策略转化为以一步 critic error 为奖励的标准 RL 问题，并据此设计主动数据选择算法。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调理论保证和可证明收敛的主动采样算法，但未给出具体环境、模型规模、baseline 或数值提升。按题目与摘要判断，实验更像验证理论趋势，而不是大规模经验研究。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Mehryar Mohri、Yishay Mansour，均是统计学习理论与强化学习方向的资深研究者；论文气质明显偏理论。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the classic failure mode in model-based RL where a simulator with low predictive error is still exploitable by a strong policy optimizer.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly theoretical and algorithmic: simulator learning is reframed as a zero-sum game between the model and an adversarial policy, with regret guarantees, critic-based simplification, and an Error-MDP duality. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to world models, agent training, reward hacking, and simulator exploitation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key move is to optimize simulators for worst-case strategic robustness rather than one-step prediction accuracy. The paper provides three pieces: learnability with sublinear regret in an online-learning formulation; a tractable critic-based bound connecting local critic loss to global policy-value gap; and an Error-MDP duality that turns worst-case policy search into a standard RL problem with one-step critic error as reward, enabling a provably convergent active data selection algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes theory and a provably convergent active sampling method, but does not report concrete environments, model sizes, baselines, or empirical gains. The empirical section is likely supportive rather than the main contribution.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Mehryar Mohri and Yishay Mansour, both well-known senior researchers in learning theory and RL; the paper is clearly theory-driven.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 不直接相连，但它把“拟合好不等于不可被 exploit”讲得很干净；若你关心 world model 或 RL 训练信号污染，只看理论主张和 Error-MDP 对偶即可。
recommendation.en: Not directly an LLM paper, but it cleanly formalizes why good prediction does not imply robustness to exploitation; read the Error-MDP duality if you care about world models or RL signal hacking.

paper.title: Open Problem: Separating Geometric and Algorithmic Compression via Cayley-Table Completion
paper.abstract: Modern statistical learning theory and deep learning characterize generalization primarily in terms of continuous capacity control (e.g., norm-based regularization, margin maximization, low-rank bias). While highly successful in continuous domains, deep learning consistently fails to extrapolate exact algorithmic or discrete algebraic rules, reflecting a missing inductive bias toward algorithmic complexity minimization. We propose the Cayley-table completion as the canonical testbed for this mis

summary.core_problem: 提出一个开放问题：如何形式化区分连续几何压缩和离散算法压缩，并解释深度学习为何难以精确外推代数规则。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是理论问题设定。它把 Cayley 表补全作为矩阵补全的离散代数对应物，用来研究模型是否具备最小化算法复杂度的归纳偏置。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将矩阵分解加权重衰减带来的低秩几何偏置，与 operator-valued tensor factorization 加 flatness prior 可能带来的离散结合律偏置进行类比。核心不是提出完整算法，而是要求建立 Cayley-table completion 的精确恢复界。
summary.experiments: 摘要未报告常规实验结果。主要内容是开放问题、理论框架和对未来恢复边界与生成机制的挑战。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper poses an open problem on separating continuous geometric compression from discrete algorithmic compression, motivated by failures of deep learning to extrapolate exact algebraic rules.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a theoretical problem formulation. It proposes Cayley-table completion as the discrete-algebraic counterpart of matrix completion for studying inductive bias toward algorithmic complexity minimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: It contrasts low-rank geometric bias induced by matrix factorization with weight decay against algorithmic bias toward exact associativity induced by operator-valued tensor factorizations with a flatness prior. The main goal is not a full algorithm, but formal exact recovery bounds.
summary_en.experiments: No standard empirical results are reported in the abstract. The work is framed as an open problem with theoretical motivation and proposed recovery questions.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 训练论文，但离散规则外推问题切中语言模型短板；当作机制备忘，不必精读。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM training paper, but its discrete-rule extrapolation framing matches a real LM weakness; keep it as a mechanism note, not a full read.

paper.title: Why LLMs Fail at Causal Discovery and How Interventional Agents Escape
paper.abstract: Causal discovery is a cornerstone of scientific reasoning, yet whether large language models can perform it reliably remains an open question. Recent benchmarks show that even fine-tuned models plateau on simple causal graphs and degrade as complexity grows, but why they fail has not been established. We prove the failure is fundamental: supervised fine-tuning, direct preference optimization, and in-context learning all produce predictors that cannot distinguish between causal graphs generating

summary.core_problem: 这项工作讨论的是：为什么 LLM 在只给观测统计或相关性描述时，难以稳定区分相近的因果图；以及是否能通过把“选图”从模型内部移到外部搜索过程来绕开这个限制。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在因果发现任务本身，而在它给出了一个有用的边界案例：SFT、DPO、ICL 在某些需要离散结构辨析的问题上，可能只是在固定表示空间里做平滑外推。若候选假设在观测分布上非常接近，模型内部表示需要很大范数才能分开它们。这提醒预训练研究者，不应把所有能力缺口都归因于数据量、模型规模或 prompt；有些问题需要外部交互信号、环境干预或显式搜索过程。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先把 SFT、DPO、ICL 统一看作 kernel-type predictor。核心假设是模型处在 lazy/NTK 近似下，训练主要改变输出层附近的函数值，特征几何变化有限。作者证明，当两个因果图生成相近的观测统计但属于不同 Markov 等价类时，有限范数的 RKHS 预测器无法可靠地区分它们；若强行分开，内部表示范数需要无界增长。为绕开这个限制，作者提出 A-CBO。它不让 LLM 直接判断哪个 DAG 正确，而是让冻结 LLM 回答简单的干预问题，例如“do(V_i=v) 后 V_j 是否变化”。外部 Bayesian optimization loop 根据这些二值回答更新候选图分布。这样，离散图选择发生在概率单纯形中，而不是在 LLM 的 kernel predictor 内部完成。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Corr2Cause，并扩展出 Extended Corr2Cause，变量数从 d=7 扩到 24。作者报告 A-CBO 在不重新训练模型的情况下达到接近微调基线的表现，并且相对 SFT 与 DPO 平均提升约 24%。优势随图复杂度增加而扩大。主要消融点是：直接让模型选图容易随变量数增长退化；把问题拆成干预查询后，外部 Bayesian 更新能更稳定地积累证据。需要注意的是，全文给出的理论依赖 lazy/kernel 近似，实验主要说明这种“LLM 作为局部 oracle + 外部搜索”的设计在该类 benchmark 上更稳，并不等价于证明通用因果发现能力已经解决。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看三处：第一，kernel obstruction theorem 的表述，确认它依赖哪些假设，尤其是 bounded RKHS norm 与 lazy training；第二，A-CBO 的算法流程，关注 LLM 输出、Bayesian update、候选 DAG 空间之间的接口；第三，Extended Corr2Cause 上随变量数增长的曲线。若只关心 LLM 预训练，可跳过因果 SCM 的常规定义，重点思考哪些任务不能靠 SFT/DPO/ICL 在固定表征中自然学出，而需要交互式数据或外部搜索。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why LLMs struggle to distinguish causal graphs from observational evidence, especially when competing graphs induce nearly identical statistics, and whether an interventional agent can avoid this failure mode.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is mostly conceptual. It frames SFT, DPO, and ICL as bounded kernel-like predictors under lazy-training assumptions, then shows a class of discrete structural decisions that such predictors cannot separate reliably. The useful lesson is that some failures are not fixed by more examples, larger prompts, or preference tuning alone. They require a different source of information, such as interventions, environment feedback, or explicit search outside the model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The theoretical part models SFT, DPO, and ICL as kernel-type predictors in an RKHS with bounded norm. Under the lazy/NTK view, the feature geometry changes little during adaptation, so predictions behave like kernel smoothing. The obstruction theorem states that near-miss causal hypotheses, which differ in graph structure but generate very similar observational statistics, cannot be cleanly separated without unbounded representation growth. The proposed escape route is A-CBO. A frozen LLM answers simple interventional questions such as whether one variable changes under a do-intervention on another variable. An external Bayesian optimization loop updates a distribution over candidate DAGs. The LLM no longer performs the discrete graph-selection step; that step happens in the probability simplex outside the RKHS setting where the obstruction applies.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Corr2Cause and an Extended Corr2Cause benchmark scaling from 7 to 24 variables. The reported result is that A-CBO matches fine-tuned baselines without retraining and outperforms SFT and DPO by about 24% on average, with the advantage increasing as graph complexity grows. The key empirical message is that direct graph selection degrades with larger causal structures, while interventional querying plus Bayesian belief updates accumulates evidence more reliably. The result should be read as evidence for the agentic decomposition, not as a general solution to causal discovery.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Focus on the statement and assumptions of the kernel obstruction theorem, the A-CBO algorithm, and the scaling curves on Extended Corr2Cause. For pretraining researchers, the most useful part is the separation between model-internal prediction and external hypothesis search. The standard SCM definitions can be read quickly unless causal discovery is a primary interest.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是那个“失败是范式内生的”论证，不一定全信，但若 theorem 条件成立，就在提醒我们别把纯文本 next-token 学习误当成可恢复因果结构的通用器；先读理论设定和反例构造。
recommendation.en: Read it for the claim that the failure is paradigm-level, not model-level; even if the theorem assumptions are narrow, it is a useful warning against treating text-only predictive training as a generic route to causal structure recovery.

paper.title: Learn from your own latents and not from tokens: A sample-complexity theory
paper.abstract: Generative models, from diffusion models to large language models, achieve remarkable performance but at a cost in training data orders of magnitude larger than what biological learners require. An alternative paradigm has emerged in which networks are trained to predict their \emph{own} latent representations of related views or masked regions, as in data2vec and JEPA -- an idea related to predictive-coding accounts of the cortex. Despite strong empirical results, the theoretical understanding

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：为什么预测模型自己的 latent 表示可能比预测原始 token 更省数据，以及显式堆叠多尺度 latent 预测模块是否真的带来额外收益。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“latent prediction 比 token reconstruction 更数据高效”这个经验判断放到可分析的层级生成模型里。结论很明确：在 Random Hierarchy Model 这一类带组合层级结构的数据上，token 级自监督目标，如 masked LM 和 diffusion，需要约 m^{L+1} 量级样本；监督端到端学习需要约 m^L；而学习自身 latent 的方法可以达到约 m^3，且不随层级深度 L 指数增长。这个结果不能直接等同于真实语言的结论，但它给 JEPA、data2vec、DINO/BYOL 类方法提供了一个清晰机制：收益来自绕开低层 token 细节，直接学习可复用的层级隐变量。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线分三层。第一，使用 Random Hierarchy Model 作为可控数据分布。RHM 是简化的 PCFG，树拓扑固定，production rules 随机，参数包括每个符号的规则数 m 和 latent tree 深度 L。它保留了组合生成和层级 latent 的关键结构，同时便于推导样本复杂度。第二，构造层级聚类算法，从约 m^3 样本恢复非根节点的完整 latent tree。这个结果说明，如果目标是发现层级 latent，而不是重构所有 token，所需数据可以不随深度 L 指数增长。第三，提出由小型 predictor-clusterer 组成的 stacked architecture，在每一层预测自身 latent，并用梯度下降端到端训练，实验上达到同样的 m^3 scaling。最后，作者分析 data2vec，认为它在单模块形式下会隐式执行层级 latent prediction，因此已经具备多尺度 latent 发现能力。这也解释了为什么显式堆叠 H-JEPA 类模块可能只带来有限增益：单个 latent-prediction 模块不一定只学一层表示。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在 RHM 合成数据上，重点不是绝对指标，而是样本复杂度随 m 和 L 的缩放关系。已知基线是：深层监督学习约需 m^L 样本；token-level SSL，包括 masked-language modelling 和 diffusion，约需 m^{L+1} 样本。作者给出的层级聚类算法、端到端 stacked predictor-clusterer，以及对 data2vec 的经验分析，都指向约 m^3 的样本复杂度。关键观察是这种 scaling 与树深 L 无关，因此相对 token 级目标有指数级差异。另一个重要实验洞察是 data2vec 的行为接近隐式层级学习，这削弱了“必须显式堆叠多个 latent prediction 模块才能获得多尺度表示”的假设。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 m^L、m^{L+1}、m^3 三个样本复杂度的对比，这是全文主线。再看 Section 3 的层级聚类算法，重点理解为什么恢复 latent tree 不需要逐 token 重构。Section 4 值得看架构设计，尤其是 predictor-clusterer 如何把可分析算法转成可训练网络。Section 5 对 data2vec 的解释最接近预训练方法启发，建议重点读其中关于“单个 latent-prediction 模块隐式学习多尺度结构”的论证。需要谨慎的地方是实验分布是 RHM，真实语言和多模态数据的长尾、噪声、语义混合会复杂很多，不能直接把 m^3 当成真实 scaling law。

summary_en.core_problem: The central question is whether predicting a model’s own latent representations can reduce sample complexity relative to token-level prediction, and whether explicit multi-scale stacking adds anything beyond what a single latent-prediction method already learns.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is a clean sample-complexity argument for latent-space prediction. On the Random Hierarchy Model, token-level self-supervised objectives such as masked language modeling and diffusion require about m^{L+1} samples, and supervised end-to-end learning requires about m^L. Latent prediction can recover the relevant hierarchy with about m^3 samples, independent of the hierarchy depth L. This is not a direct scaling law for real language, but it gives a concrete mechanism for why data2vec, JEPA-like methods, BYOL, and DINO can be more data-efficient than raw reconstruction objectives: they avoid spending capacity and samples on low-level token details when the useful structure lives in reusable latent variables.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis uses the Random Hierarchy Model, a simplified probabilistic context-free grammar with fixed tree topology and random production rules. The model is parameterized by the number of rules per symbol m and the tree depth L, which makes it possible to separate dependence on local combinatorics from dependence on hierarchy depth. The first contribution is a hierarchical clustering algorithm that recovers the non-root latent tree with O(m^3) samples. The second is an end-to-end architecture built from small predictor-clusterer modules; each level predicts its own latent variables, and gradient descent reaches the same scaling on the RHM. The third is a theory of data2vec: under the paper’s assumptions and empirical checks, data2vec behaves as an implicit hierarchical latent predictor. This differs from token reconstruction because the target is not the raw observation, but a learned representation that becomes more abstract over training.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are organized around scaling on synthetic RHM data. The relevant baselines are known from prior RHM analyses: deep supervised learning scales as roughly m^L samples, while token-level SSL objectives such as MLM and diffusion scale as roughly m^{L+1}. The proposed hierarchical clustering procedure, the trainable stacked predictor-clusterer architecture, and the empirical analysis of data2vec all support O(m^3) sample complexity. The important empirical point is that the dependence on L disappears. Another useful observation is that data2vec already appears to perform multi-scale latent discovery implicitly, which helps explain why explicit hierarchical variants such as H-JEPA may show only moderate gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Plan for a 30–45 minute skim. Start with the introduction’s comparison between m^L, m^{L+1}, and m^3, since that frames the whole argument. Then read Section 3 for the hierarchical clustering construction and why latent recovery avoids token reconstruction. Section 4 is useful for understanding how the algorithmic idea is turned into a trainable predictor-clusterer stack. Section 5 is the most relevant part for pretraining methodology, especially the claim that data2vec implicitly performs hierarchical latent prediction. The main caveat is the synthetic data model: RHM isolates compositional hierarchy, but real language and multimodal data include noise, ambiguity, long-tail semantics, and mixed generative factors.

recommendation.zh: 值得看定理 setup：若 PCFG 假设足够干净，它会改变 latent prediction 是否真省数据的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the theorem setup; if the PCFG assumptions are clean, it updates the prior on whether latent prediction actually buys data efficiency.

paper.title: Noise Schedule Design for Diffusion Models: An Optimal Control Perspective
paper.abstract: We develop a principled framework for analyzing and designing noise schedules in diffusion models. We show that one can recast this design problem as an optimal control problem, whose state is the Fisher information of the diffusion process which evolves according to an ODE and the control input is the noise schedule. The objective of the optimal control problem is a functional involving the Fisher information, which is shown to be an upper bound on the Kullback-Leibler sampling error. By solvin

summary.core_problem: 研究扩散模型中 noise schedule 如何设计，目标是在有限离散步数下控制采样误差。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是理论分析和方法框架：把 noise schedule 设计转化为最优控制问题，并用 Fisher information 的演化来刻画采样误差上界。对图像/连续扩散模型更直接，对 diffusion LM 研究是间接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 将扩散过程的 Fisher information 作为状态变量，noise schedule 作为控制输入，构造一个以 KL sampling error 上界为目标的最优控制问题。通过求解该问题，给出达到约 O(d/n) 采样误差的充分条件，其中 d 是数据维度，n 是离散化步数。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要报告理论结果，没有给出模型规模、训练数据或大规模生成实验。关键结果是：相比已有理论只覆盖特定 schedule，本文试图覆盖更接近实践中使用的 schedule，并给出 O(d/n) 级别采样误差条件。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign 和 Carnegie Mellon University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to design noise schedules for diffusion models so that sampling error remains controlled under a finite number of discretization steps.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly theoretical: it formulates noise schedule design as an optimal control problem and analyzes sampling error through the Fisher information dynamics. The direct target is continuous diffusion models, with only indirect relevance to diffusion language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Fisher information of the diffusion process is treated as the state, while the noise schedule is treated as the control input. The objective is a functional that upper-bounds KL sampling error. Solving this control problem yields sufficient schedule conditions for achieving roughly O(d/n) sampling error, where d is data dimension and n is the number of discretization steps.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes theoretical guarantees rather than empirical model runs. The main stated result is that the framework can cover schedules closer to practical use, while prior bounds were limited to specific schedules.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and Carnegie Mellon University.

recommendation.zh: 做 diffusion LM 可扫 abstract 和定理条件；它不改语言建模 prior，但 schedule 设计的控制视角可借用。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick scan if you work on diffusion LMs; it will not change LM priors, but the control view of schedule design is reusable.

paper.title: A Boundary-Layer Mechanism for One-Third Scaling in Online Softmax Classification
paper.abstract: Hard-label classification is usually trained with smooth surrogate losses, most prominently softmax cross-entropy. We isolate an asymptotic mechanism by which this mismatch between smooth surrogate and discrete labels produces power-law learning curves in an online teacher-student model. After subtracting the mean logit, the thermodynamic-limit dynamics close in centered variables: a growing centered student-teacher alignment $D$ and the residual student variance $Δ$. At late times, examples awa

summary.core_problem: 解释在线 softmax 交叉熵分类中，为何测试损失和泛化误差在晚期训练呈现 α^{-1/3} 的幂律，而不是更快的 Bayes-optimal 收敛。
summary.importance: 这是基础学习动力学分析。价值不在直接改进 LLM，而在于给出一个清晰机制：平滑 surrogate loss 与离散标签不匹配时，晚期学习被决策边界附近的边界层主导，导致慢幂律收敛。这类结论对理解 cross-entropy 训练尾段动态有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 online teacher-student 模型中分析 softmax 分类，减去均值 logit 后把动力学闭合到 centered student-teacher alignment D 与残余方差 Δ 两个变量；证明远离教师决策边界的样本贡献指数衰减，只剩宽度 O(D^{-1}) 的边界层持续驱动更新，而固定学习率噪声维持非零 Δ，最终推出 α^{-1/3} 标度。
summary.experiments: 核心是理论推导与热力学极限分析，辅以 teacher-student 设置下的数值验证。不是大规模神经网络实验，也没有 LLM 规模结果；更像对损失尾部学习曲线的机制解释。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Leipzig University 理论物理研究所，属于统计物理/理论学习动力学路线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains why online softmax classification exhibits a late-time power law of α^{-1/3} in both test loss and generalization error, instead of a faster Bayes-optimal decay.
summary_en.importance: This is a learning-dynamics analysis paper. Its value is not direct LLM improvement, but a clean mechanism: when a smooth surrogate loss is used for hard-label classification, late-stage learning is dominated by boundary-layer examples near decision boundaries, yielding slow power-law convergence. That is relevant to how we think about cross-entropy tail dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using an online teacher-student model, the authors subtract the mean logit and close the dynamics in two centered variables: student-teacher alignment D and residual student variance Δ. They show that examples far from teacher decision boundaries contribute exponentially little at late times, leaving only an O(D^{-1}) boundary layer active, while fixed-learning-rate SGD noise keeps Δ nonzero, producing the α^{-1/3} scaling.
summary_en.experiments: The work is primarily theoretical, with numerical validation in teacher-student settings. It is not a large-scale neural network study and contains no LLM-scale experiments; it is best read as a mechanism paper for late-stage loss dynamics.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Institute for Theoretical Physics at Leipzig University, in the statistical-physics / theoretical learning-dynamics tradition.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但对“为什么 cross-entropy 尾段学得慢”给了少见的干净机制；只看理论主结论和边界层解释即可，别外推到真实 pretrain 太远。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but it gives a rare clean mechanism for why cross-entropy tails can learn slowly; read the boundary-layer argument, but do not overgeneralize to real pretraining.

institutions: Institute for Theoretical Physics, Leipzig University

paper.title: The General Theory of Localization Methods
paper.abstract: This paper proposes a general machine learning framework called the localization method, which is fundamentally built on two core concepts: localization kernels and local means -- key components that underpin the self-attention mechanism. To establish a rigorous theoretical foundation, the framework is formally defined through two essential pillars: the formulation of the local(-ized) model and the localization trick. We systematically investigate the connections between the localization method

summary.core_problem: 尝试用 localization kernels 和 local means 建立一个统一机器学习框架，并把 self-attention 放进该框架解释。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是理论统一与概念整理。它把 kernel methods、lazy learning、MeanShift、Hopfield networks、LLE、fuzzy inference、denoising autoencoders 等方法放在同一个 localization method 视角下讨论。对 LLM 的价值主要在 attention 机制解释，而不是预训练 recipe 或可直接复现实验。
summary.technical_approach: 形式化定义 local model 与 localization trick，将局部核函数和局部均值作为核心对象；随后逐一建立它们与已有模型的对应关系。self-attention 被解释为依赖 localization kernel 和 local mean 的一种局部化计算。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体 LLM、数据规模、训练实验或 benchmark 结果；更像理论框架与方法关系梳理。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Beijing Institute of Mathematical Sciences and Applications。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper attempts to build a unified machine-learning framework around localization kernels and local means, and places self-attention within that framework.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is conceptual and theoretical unification. It connects kernel methods, lazy learning, MeanShift, Hopfield networks, LLE, fuzzy inference, and denoising autoencoders through a localization-method lens. Its relevance to LLMs is mainly interpretive rather than practical for pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It formally defines localized models and a localization trick, then maps existing algorithms to these primitives. Self-attention is interpreted as a computation based on localization kernels and local means.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete LLM experiments, data scale, or benchmark results; the work appears primarily theoretical.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is from the Beijing Institute of Mathematical Sciences and Applications.

recommendation.zh: 只看 attention 相关定义即可；统一框架跨度很大，若没有可检验预测，难改变预训练侧的设计判断。
recommendation.en: Read only the attention-related formalization; the unification is broad, and without testable predictions it should not move pretraining design priors much.

institutions: Beijing Institute of Mathematical Sciences and Applications

paper.title: Conditional Equivalence of DPO and RLHF: Implicit Assumption, Failure Modes, and Provable Alignment
paper.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as a popular alternative to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), offering theoretical equivalence with simpler implementation. We prove this equivalence is conditional rather than universal, depending on an implicit assumption frequently violated in practice: the RLHF-optimal policy must prefer human-preferred responses. When this assumption fails, DPO optimizes relative advantage over the reference policy rather than absolute alignm

summary.core_problem: 重新审视 DPO 与 RLHF 的理论等价性，指出该等价依赖一个实践中可能被破坏的隐含假设。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是对齐目标的理论分析与方法修正。它挑战了“DPO 是 RLHF 简化等价形式”的常见理解，并给出 DPO 可能降低 loss 却偏向人类不喜欢响应的失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: 作者证明 DPO-RLHF 等价不是无条件成立，而要求 RLHF 最优策略必须偏好人类偏好的回答；当该假设失败时，DPO 优化的是相对 reference policy 的 advantage，而不是相对人类偏好的绝对对齐。论文进一步刻画不良解空间，给出几何解释，并提出 Constrained Preference Optimization，在 RLHF 中加入约束以获得可证明对齐。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型规模、数据集、baseline 或具体数值。可确认内容以理论证明、失败模式构造、几何解释和 CPO 的可证明性质为主，可能包含验证 DPO 病态收敛的实验但摘要未列数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits the claimed equivalence between DPO and RLHF and identifies an implicit assumption that can fail in practice.
summary_en.importance: This is a theoretical analysis and objective-level correction for alignment training. It challenges the common view that DPO is a universally equivalent simplification of RLHF and exposes cases where DPO loss can decrease while the policy prefers dispreferred responses.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors prove that DPO-RLHF equivalence is conditional: the RLHF-optimal policy must prefer human-preferred responses. When this condition fails, DPO optimizes relative advantage over the reference policy rather than absolute alignment with human preferences. They characterize the undesirable solution space, provide a geometric interpretation, and introduce Constrained Preference Optimization by adding constraints to RLHF for provable alignment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical results. The reported contribution is mainly theoretical, including proofs, failure-mode characterization, geometric analysis, and the proposed CPO objective.

recommendation.zh: 必须看定理条件和失败构造；它会修正“DPO≈RLHF”的默认 prior，尤其影响偏好数据噪声下的目标选择。
recommendation.en: Read the theorem conditions and failure construction; it revises the default “DPO≈RLHF” prior, especially for objective choice under noisy preference data.

paper.title: A Measure-Theoretic Analysis of Reasoning: Structural Generalization and Approximation Limits
paper.abstract: While empirical scaling laws for LLM reasoning are well-documented, the theoretical mechanisms governing out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization remain elusive. We formalize reasoning via optimal transport, projecting discrete trajectories into a continuous metric space to quantify domain shifts using the Wasserstein-1 distance. Invoking Kantorovich duality, we bound OOD generalization via architectural Lipschitz continuity and functional approximation limits. This exposes two primary constrain

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文想回答一个理论问题：自回归 Transformer 在训练于较浅、较短推理轨迹后，为什么会在更深、更长、结构发生位移的 OOD 推理任务上失效。作者把问题具体化为四个变量的耦合：数据分布的结构位移、位置编码带来的几何稳定性、模型宽度的函数逼近能力、模型物理深度的顺序计算能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在两个方面。第一，它把 reasoning generalization 从“多做数据或多加参数”的经验讨论，转成了位置编码、深度、宽度和分布位移共同决定的风险界。第二，它给出一个清晰判断：对需要长程顺序计算和递归回溯的任务，单纯增加宽度可能无法替代深度；位置编码若破坏平移等变性，会在长度外推和结构位移场景中引入稳定的误差项。贡献更偏理论框架和解释工具，不是可直接落地的预训练算法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先把离散推理轨迹投影到连续的结构度量空间，特征包括 nesting depth、backtracking rate 等可描述推理轨迹形状的量。这样，一个推理数据集就可以表示为该空间上的 pushforward probability measure，不同训练/测试任务之间的结构差异可用 Wasserstein-1 距离刻画。随后作者引入 epsilon-relaxed structural sufficiency 假设，将离散 zero-one loss 近似为结构空间上的 Lipschitz risk function，并用 Kantorovich duality 得到目标域风险界。这个界由三类因素控制：Wasserstein 分布位移、架构诱导的 Lipschitz 常数，以及宽度/深度的函数逼近限制。论文进一步分析两类架构约束。位置编码方面，APE 的注意力核依赖绝对坐标，轨迹整体平移会改变局部注意力结构，因此得到 Ω(1) 级别的结构 Lipschitz gap；RoPE 作为相对位置机制，更接近平移等变，能避免这种坐标扰动。计算复杂度方面，作者把递归回溯结构映射到 Dyck-k language，并引用 balanced parenthesis matching 的 NC1 难度，说明固定深度 Transformer 的 TC0 型计算限制会形成顺序推理截断边界；宽度扩展只能缓解表示逼近误差，不能绕过深度不足带来的顺序计算瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 实验设计是合成式验证，而不是在通用数学 benchmark 上刷分。作者构造了 54 个架构配置，覆盖 Small/Medium/Large 三种规模、Deep/Wide/Balanced 三种形状，以及 APE/RoPE 两类位置编码。目标分布在结构代理空间中合成，包括浅层横向状态扩展、深层递归回溯、高度平移的组合混合分布。关键观察包括：深层、高顺序性的结构上，准确率受到理论中 TC0 深度上界的限制；在参数量增加时，扩宽模型会出现平台期或退化，而增加物理层数带来更稳定的性能轨迹；在强坐标位移的混合分布下，宽 APE 模型会出现表示崩塌，RoPE 的表现更稳定。给出的正文片段没有暴露完整表格数值，因此不宜补写具体准确率。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25 到 35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对四个变量的统一定义，确认作者不是单独讨论 length extrapolation，而是把分布位移和电路复杂度放在同一个框架里。随后看 optimal transport 建模、epsilon-relaxed structural sufficiency 和 Kantorovich duality 推导，这几处决定了风险界是否可信。位置编码部分重点看 APE 与 RoPE 的 Lipschitz gap 证明；深度部分重点看 Dyck-k、NC1、TC0 的连接是否依赖过强假设。实验部分重点看 54 个配置的 controlled distribution 设计，以及 deep/wide/balanced 的趋势图。需要带着怀疑读：结构投影是否足以代表真实 reasoning trajectory，是这套理论能否解释预训练实践的关键。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why autoregressive Transformers trained on shallow reasoning trajectories fail under deeper, longer, and structurally shifted OOD reasoning settings. It frames the issue as an interaction among four factors: structural distribution shift, the geometric stability induced by positional encoding, width-based approximation capacity, and physical depth for sequential computation.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is conceptual rather than procedural. It gives a way to reason about reasoning generalization beyond parameter count and dataset size. The paper argues that for tasks involving recursive backtracking and long sequential computation, increasing width cannot fully substitute for increasing depth. It also makes positional encoding part of the generalization bound: position mechanisms that break translation equivariance can introduce a persistent OOD error term. This is useful for thinking about length extrapolation, reasoning data curricula, and architecture choices, but it is not a direct pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors project discrete reasoning trajectories into a continuous structural metric space using features such as nesting depth and backtracking rate. A dataset then becomes a pushforward probability measure, and train-test structural shift can be measured by the Wasserstein-1 distance. They introduce an epsilon-relaxed structural sufficiency assumption so that discrete zero-one loss can be approximated by a Lipschitz structural risk function. Kantorovich duality then yields a target-risk bound controlled by three terms: Wasserstein domain shift, the architecture-induced Lipschitz constant, and functional approximation limits tied to width and depth. The positional-encoding analysis compares APE and RoPE. APE depends on absolute coordinates, so global shifts of a trajectory alter local attention kernels and lead to an Ω(1) structural Lipschitz gap. RoPE better preserves relative, translation-equivariant structure. The depth analysis maps recursive backtracking to Dyck-k languages and uses the NC1 hardness of balanced parentheses to argue that fixed-depth TC0-style Transformers face a sequential computation boundary that width scaling cannot remove.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section uses controlled synthetic distributions rather than standard reasoning benchmarks. The paper evaluates 54 architectural configurations across Small/Medium/Large scales, Deep/Wide/Balanced aspect ratios, and APE/RoPE positional encodings. The target distributions isolate shallow lateral expansion, deep recursive backtracking, and translated compositional mixtures. The reported findings are consistent with the theory: accuracy on deep sequential structures is capped by the derived depth-related limitation; widening alone plateaus or degrades, while increasing physical depth gives a stronger performance trajectory; under severe coordinate shifts, wide APE models suffer representation collapse, whereas RoPE is more stable. The provided text does not include complete numeric tables, so exact accuracy values should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus first on how the paper defines the structural metric space and why Wasserstein-1 is used for domain shift. Then read the epsilon-relaxed sufficiency assumption and the Kantorovich-duality step, because these carry most of the theoretical load. The APE-vs-RoPE section is the most directly relevant part for architecture work. The Dyck-k/NC1/TC0 argument is worth checking for assumption strength. In the experiments, focus on the design of the 54 controlled configurations and the deep-vs-wide trends. The main point to scrutinize is whether the chosen structural projection captures the aspects of reasoning trajectories that matter in real pretraining data.

recommendation.zh: 不是能直接改配方的论文，但它把“位置编码伤 OOD”和“深度对回溯推理必要”讲成了可证明命题；先看位置编码那部分，若证明条件不太苛刻，值得拿内部合成任务复核。
recommendation.en: Not a recipe paper, but it turns two fuzzy priors—positional encoding hurts OOD and depth matters for backtracking—into explicit claims; read the positional section first and sanity-check the assumptions before taking it seriously.

paper.title: NOVA: Fundamental Limits of Knowledge Discovery Through AI
paper.abstract: Can AI systems discover genuinely new knowledge through iterative self improvement, and if so, at what cost? We introduce the NOVA framework, which models the common ``generate, verify, accumulate, retrain'' loop as an adaptive sampling process over a knowledge space. We identify sufficient conditions under which accumulated genuine knowledge eventually covers a finite domain, and show how their violations produce distinct failure modes: contamination, forgetting, exploration failure, and accept

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论 AI 系统通过“生成候选、验证、累积、再训练”的循环能否发现新知识，以及发现成本如何随时间增长。它把自训练、形式化证明、自博弈和递归合成数据训练放到同一个抽象框架里，核心关注四个瓶颈：模型是否能采到目标知识、验证器是否能识别有效样本、训练后是否保留已发现知识、未知知识前沿是否会变得越来越稀薄。
summary.importance: 对预训练和自改进研究的启发在于，它把“用模型生成数据再训练模型”的问题从经验技巧提升到可分析的采样过程。结论比较克制但有用：自举发现并不只受模型能力限制，还受候选分布尾部、验证误报率、遗忘和支持集覆盖共同约束。尤其是污染陷阱值得关注。当前沿有效样本概率下降时，固定的 false positive rate 会变得不安全，错误样本可能比真实新知识更快进入知识库。这对 RL self-training、自动合成 reasoning data、形式化验证数据闭环都有直接警示。
summary.technical_approach: NOVA 将知识发现建模为有限或可数知识空间上的自适应采样。模型在环境候选空间中生成 artifact，验证器决定接受或拒绝，已接受样本进入知识库，并影响后续模型分布。论文分别刻画了成功覆盖有限知识域所需的充分条件，以及条件破坏后的失败模式：reachability 不足导致 exploration failure；验证器拒绝有效样本导致 acceptance failure；训练后概率质量从已发现知识上消失导致 forgetting；无效样本被接受导致 contamination。相比只讨论 model collapse 的工作，NOVA 不只看递归训练造成的分布退化，而是把生成分布、验证质量、知识保留和未知前沿同时纳入分析。论文还区分了 Good–Turing 的 batch unseen mass 和长期发现过程中的 historically undiscovered valid mass，并在尾部分布近似 Zipf、指数 α>1 的假设下推出发现 D 个不同真实 artifact 的累计生成成本为 Θ(c_gen D^α)。这给“越往后越难发现”的直觉提供了明确的成本律。
summary.experiments: 这是一篇理论建模论文，重点不是实证 benchmark。主要结果是若有限目标知识域中每个有效 artifact 在长期生成过程中保持正可达概率、验证器能接受有效 artifact、训练过程保留已发现知识，则知识覆盖可几乎必然发生。若存在 imperfect verification，论文分析有效样本和无效样本的增长率，得到局部污染阈值：当新有效知识的模型质量变小，验证器可容忍的误报率也必须同步下降；否则即使误报率很小，也会在后期积累污染。发现成本部分给出 R_cum(D)=Θ(c_gen D^α)，其中 c_gen 是单个候选生成成本，α 是有效发现前沿的 Zipf 尾指数。这个结果解释了为什么简单扩大采样预算在后期收益下降明显。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–45 分钟。重点看形式化定义、收敛条件和 imperfect verification 部分。对预训练研究更有用的是 contamination threshold 和 discovery-cost scaling，而不是符号细节。若正在做自动数据合成、proof/RL verifier、self-training 或持续预训练，应仔细看失败模式的划分：它能帮助区分是模型采不到、验证器太弱、训练忘掉，还是知识库被污染。人类专家 amplification 部分也值得扫读，它给出了为什么 frontier 阶段仍需要外部引导的形式化解释。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether an AI system can discover genuinely new knowledge through a repeated generate–verify–accumulate–retrain loop, and how the cost of discovery scales as the easy part of the domain is exhausted. It frames self-training, formal theorem proving, self-play, and recursive synthetic-data training as instances of the same adaptive sampling process over a knowledge space.
summary_en.importance: The useful contribution for pretraining research is a clean separation of the failure modes in model-driven data generation. Discovery is not limited only by model capacity. It also depends on support coverage, verifier quality, retention after retraining, and the probability mass assigned to the remaining unknown frontier. The contamination result is especially relevant for RL-based self-training and synthetic reasoning data pipelines: when valid new samples become rare, a fixed false-positive rate can become unsafe, because invalid artifacts may enter the retained corpus faster than genuine discoveries.
summary_en.technical_approach: NOVA models discovery as adaptive sampling from an ambient candidate space containing valid and invalid artifacts. A generator proposes candidates, a verifier accepts or rejects them, accepted candidates are accumulated, and retraining changes the future sampling distribution. The analysis gives sufficient conditions for almost-sure coverage of a finite target domain and maps violations of those conditions to forgetting, exploration failure, acceptance failure, and contamination. This is broader than standard model-collapse analyses, which mainly focus on distributional degradation under recursive training. The paper also separates Good–Turing batch unseen mass from the historically undiscovered valid mass that drives long-run discovery. Under a tail-equivalence assumption with a Zipf exponent α>1, the cumulative generation cost for discovering D distinct valid artifacts scales as Θ(c_gen D^α).
summary_en.experiments: This is a theoretical paper rather than an empirical benchmark paper. The main results are convergence guarantees under reachability, acceptance, and retention assumptions; failure characterizations when those assumptions break; and a contamination threshold under imperfect verification. The imperfect-verifier analysis shows that as the generator assigns less mass to new valid artifacts, the acceptable false-positive rate must also shrink. The cost law R_cum(D)=Θ(c_gen D^α) quantifies the diminishing return of brute-force sampling near the discovery frontier.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. The most relevant parts are the formal setup, the convergence and failure-mode results, the imperfect-verification analysis, and the discovery-cost scaling theorem. For readers working on synthetic data, verifier-guided RL, formal proof generation, or continual pretraining, the contamination and frontier-thinning sections are the parts to read carefully. The human-amplification discussion is also useful because it explains why expert guidance remains valuable when autonomous sampling assigns very low probability to undiscovered valid artifacts.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 self-training、synthetic data 或 model collapse，这篇值得读；它不直接给 recipe，但把“验证器稍差也会越训越脏”讲成了可推演的机制。
recommendation.en: Read this if you care about self-training or synthetic-data loops; it gives no recipe, but it turns “slightly noisy verification poisons the loop” into a clean mechanism worth stress-testing internally.

paper.title: Support Before Frequency in Discrete Diffusion
paper.abstract: Discrete diffusion models are increasingly competitive for language modeling, yet it remains unclear how their denoising objectives organize learning. Although these objectives target the full data distribution, we show that the exact reverse process induces a hierarchy between coarse support information and finer frequency information. For uniform and absorbing (a.k.a. masking) diffusion, we prove that, in the small-noise regime of the final denoising steps, each single-token reverse edit decom

summary.core_problem: 离散扩散语言模型（DLM）作为自回归语言模型的替代方案发展迅速，但现有研究对其去噪目标的学习优先级、信息层级结构缺乏清晰的理论解释，无法明确DLM训练过程中不同类型数据特征的学习顺序。
summary.importance: 从理论层面证明了离散扩散模型的「先支持集后频率」学习规律，解释了DLM的训练动态，为DLM的训练目标设计、推理加速、性能优化提供了理论依据，同时明确了掩码扩散（吸收扩散）相比均匀扩散在支持集识别上的优势，对扩散语言建模的范式迭代有直接指导价值。
summary.technical_approach: 对离散扩散的反向核做小噪声极限分析，将单token反向编辑概率分解为两个层级：主导层级由编辑是否向数据支持集（即合法序列集合）移动决定，精细层级由支持集内部的序列相对频率决定；证明当模型学到的反向概率与真实反向概率的乘法误差在o(σ^-1/2)量级时，即可准确识别向支持集移动的编辑方向，不需要精确拟合频率信息；对比均匀扩散和掩码扩散的结构差异，证明掩码扩散下仅支持集改进的去掩码操作在小噪声区处于主导阶，非改进操作的贡献可忽略。
summary.experiments: 1. 在FineWeb数据集上训练掩码DLM，设计探测任务分离支持集定位和频率排序能力，发现支持集定位的性能增益达到峰值的时间远早于频率排序，验证了先支持集后频率的学习顺序；2. 在正则语言的合成实验上验证了掩码扩散的支持集投影特性，基于理论设计的无额外训练的推理阈值策略可有效分离主导阶的支持集改进分量。测试覆盖不同随机种子，结论稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第2节的理论推导（重点是定理2.1、2.2和推论2.1）、第3节的实验设计与结果（重点是图1的训练动态曲线），附录A的离散扩散目标等价性推导、附录B的误差示例可作为补充材料阅读；值得深挖的点包括该规律在大参数量DLM上的缩放特性、基于该规律设计的新型训练课程、针对支持集优化的推理加速策略。

summary_en.core_problem: Discrete Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) are developing rapidly as an alternative to autoregressive language models, but existing research lacks clear theoretical explanations for the learning priority and information hierarchy of their denoising objectives, and cannot clarify the learning order of different types of data features during DLM training.
summary_en.importance: It theoretically proves the "support before frequency" learning rule of discrete diffusion models, explains the training dynamics of DLMs, provides theoretical basis for DLM training objective design, inference acceleration and performance optimization, and clarifies the advantage of absorbing (masking) diffusion over uniform diffusion in support set identification, which has direct guiding value for paradigm iteration of diffusion language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: It conducts small-noise limit analysis on the reverse kernel of discrete diffusion, and decomposes single-token reverse edit probability into two levels: the leading level is determined by whether the edit moves toward the data support set (the set of valid sequences), and the fine level is determined by relative frequency of sequences within the support set. It proves that when the multiplicative error between the learned reverse probability and the true reverse probability is in the order of o(σ^-1/2), the model can accurately identify edit directions moving toward the support set without precise fitting of frequency information. It also compares structural differences between uniform diffusion and masking diffusion, proving that only support-improving unmasking operations are in the leading order in the small-noise regime for masking diffusion, while contributions of non-improving operations are negligible.
summary_en.experiments: 1.
